00407d926e29.en: “Going to the duel?” A gray-haired man with blue hair strands at one side asked with a rather uncaring monotone, holding the contract Harry signed not long ago—at least based on Harry’s feeling of how much time has passed.
00407d926e29.t: “Mau ke duel?” Seorang pria berambut abu-abu dengan helai-helai rambut biru di satu sisi bertanya dengan nada monoton yang agak acuh tak acuh, memegang kontrak yang ditandatangani Harry belum lama ini—setidaknya menurut perasaan Harry tentang berapa lama waktu telah berlalu.

02a9b75b5678.en: “Yes! Finally!—who are you?” The anger in the girl’s voice disappeared, leaving behind a certain elegance, and charm.
02a9b75b5678.t: “Ya! Akhirnya!—kau siapa?” Amarah dalam suara gadis itu menghilang, meninggalkan keanggunan dan pesona tertentu.

04a280ff24f9.en: My nose! Waa! I can’t breathe! Her anger pushed Harry’s head so far into the pillow that it felt like it was about to break inwards and pierce his skull—I can’t breathe! It hurts! Harry began losing his breath, and his groans turned into muffled screams, “EIRI! HELP!” He used his last breath to call for her, but nothing happened. His entire body felt chilled, as if he had just taken a cold shower. His heart was throttling back, apparently betraying his own racing mind. With his arms and legs growing completely numb, and forcibly relaxing too, he tried to flay them around with one last hurrah, but they also betrayed him. Most of his body, at least where he thought they would be, was now replaced with a waning tingle mixed with numbness. Like a dying fish, Harry was growing less agitated, but if you looked closely into its eye, you could still see the looming doom.
04a280ff24f9.t: Hidungku! Waa! Aku tidak bisa bernapas! Amarahnya menekan kepala Harry begitu dalam ke bantal sampai terasa seolah kepalanya akan patah ke dalam dan menembus tengkoraknya—Aku tidak bisa bernapas! Sakit! Harry mulai kehabisan napas, dan erangannya berubah menjadi teriakan teredam, “EIRI! TOLONG!” Ia memakai napas terakhirnya untuk memanggilnya, tetapi tidak terjadi apa-apa. Seluruh tubuhnya terasa dingin, seolah ia baru saja mandi air dingin. Jantungnya melambat, tampaknya mengkhianati pikirannya sendiri yang berpacu. Dengan lengan dan kakinya menjadi mati rasa sepenuhnya, dan terpaksa mengendur juga, ia mencoba menggerak-gerakkannya dengan satu usaha terakhir, tetapi keduanya juga mengkhianatinya. Sebagian besar tubuhnya, setidaknya di tempat yang ia kira, kini digantikan oleh kesemutan yang memudar bercampur mati rasa. Seperti ikan yang sekarat, Harry semakin tidak gelisah, tetapi kalau kamu melihat dekat-dekat ke matanya, kamu masih bisa melihat malapetaka yang membayang.

0588a89d8de2.en: Hmm. He looks pissed, so maybe I should keep it shut. Walking out into the courtyard, Harry felt the true shine of the sun, ticklishly warming his skin, and invading his eyes. He looked at the sky, and saw a beautiful summer day with barely any clouds around. Soothing the warmness of the sun, a weak gust of brisk wind passed by, playing with the green grass, and flowers.
0588a89d8de2.t: Hmm. Dia kelihatan kesal, jadi mungkin sebaiknya aku diam saja. Berjalan keluar ke halaman, Harry merasakan sinar matahari yang sesungguhnya, menghangatkan kulitnya dengan menggelitik, dan menyerbu matanya. Ia memandang langit, dan melihat hari musim panas yang indah dengan nyaris tak ada awan. Menyejukkan hangatnya matahari, embusan angin segar yang lemah lewat, mempermainkan rumput hijau dan bunga-bunga.

05ef73da6d48.en: Harry, lost in the conversation between these strangers, noticed a glint of light coming from where the Sanbi royals stood. Looking back, he saw Kibe energizing a spell. The white rings around his hands had two red balls of DNA strands circling about, right before he released it on Neferteri’s hands. The spell took a quick effect on her, swelling up her chin and neck, like she had developed goiter out of the blue.
05ef73da6d48.t: Harry, tersesat dalam percakapan antara orang-orang asing ini, memperhatikan kilatan cahaya yang datang dari tempat para Sanbi royal berdiri. Menoleh, ia melihat Kibe sedang mengisi sebuah mantra. Cincin-cincin putih di sekitar tangannya punya dua bola merah berupa untaian DNA yang berputar-putar, tepat sebelum ia melepaskannya ke tangan Neferteri. Mantra itu cepat bekerja padanya, membuat dagu dan lehernya membengkak, seolah ia tiba-tiba terkena gondok.

06e324e4de2b.en: The spectators around all looked intrigued, awaiting Sora to come out of her shell. Meanwhile, talking in the background started.
06e324e4de2b.t: Para penonton di sekitar semuanya tampak tertarik, menunggu Sora keluar dari cangkangnya. Sementara itu, obrolan di latar belakang dimulai.

07061dc62387.en: Kibe, now also with a swollen neck and chin from applying the same spell on himself, while Neferteri was going about her business, lifted his badge kinda above his head—perhaps an unwillingness to go all the way up, or a certain air of laziness. He then unscrambled a folded paper from his pocket, and read it as confidently as a college student presenting a research paper he threw together the night before. “Yesterday, Gabiro screwed up a research spell trying to get Fanchakis to be larger. He says he is sorry, but he can’t come in today, so I'm covering for him.” He put his badge away, and put the rolled contract up in the air instead. “If Harry wins, he will get Maiara’s hand. If he loses, he’s gonna have a debt of five hundred sapphires and work as Sanbi-eye until the debt is repaid.”
07061dc62387.t: Kibe, kini juga dengan leher dan dagu yang bengkak karena memakai mantra yang sama pada dirinya sendiri, sementara Neferteri sibuk dengan urusannya, mengangkat lencananya agak di atas kepalanya—mungkin karena enggan mengangkatnya sampai tinggi, atau aura malas tertentu. Ia lalu membuka lipatan kertas dari sakunya, dan membacanya sepercaya diri mahasiswa yang mempresentasikan makalah penelitian yang ia buat asal-asalan semalam sebelumnya. “Kemarin, Gabiro mengacaukan mantra penelitian yang berusaha membuat Fanchaki lebih besar. Dia bilang dia minta maaf, tapi dia tidak bisa datang hari ini, jadi aku menggantikannya.” Ia menyimpan lencananya, dan malah mengangkat kontrak yang digulung ke udara. “Kalau Harry menang, dia akan mendapatkan tangan Maiara. Kalau dia kalah, dia akan punya utang lima ratus sapphire dan bekerja sebagai Sanbi-eye sampai utangnya lunas.”

0735543816ab.en: Harry’s heart skipped a beat, feeling like someone punched his guts from the inside. With rushed steps, he made his way towards Kibe, and kept himself to no more than two steps away from him, nearly stepping on his shoes. They walked past the large boxy castle, revealing to Harry what was beyond it for the first time, a large wooden door with a highly intricate jumping Sanbi blue fish illustration about the height of two men. *Eiri never mentioned that—*feeling an urge to know more, Harry could not help himself. “Excuse me—sorry, but why?”
0735543816ab.t: Jantung Harry berdegup tak beraturan, merasa seperti seseorang meninju perutnya dari dalam. Dengan langkah tergesa, ia berjalan ke arah Kibe, dan menjaga dirinya tidak lebih dari dua langkah darinya, nyaris menginjak sepatunya. Mereka berjalan melewati kastil besar berbentuk kotak, memperlihatkan kepada Harry apa yang ada di baliknya untuk pertama kalinya, sebuah pintu kayu besar dengan ilustrasi ikan biru Sanbi yang melompat yang sangat rumit, kira-kira setinggi dua orang pria. *Eiri tidak pernah menyebutkan itu—*merasakan dorongan untuk tahu lebih banyak, Harry tidak bisa menahan diri. “Permisi—maaf, tapi kenapa?”

083fa2d7700e.en: Sora revealed her tomato-red face to the public, and quickly smelled Harry’s hand. Closing her eyes, she stuck out her tongue to lick his hand, right in the same spot as she did to Maiara—between the middle and ring fingers. She seemingly kept trying to taste something as her mouth grew slack, only to then face Eiri with an open stare. “I’m sorry king-maid, but my senses are off.” Her saddening speech was not its usual rap-pace, more like G-funk.
083fa2d7700e.t: Sora memperlihatkan wajahnya yang merah seperti tomat kepada publik, dan cepat-cepat mencium tangan Harry. Memejamkan matanya, ia menjulurkan lidahnya untuk menjilat tangannya, tepat di tempat yang sama seperti yang ia lakukan pada Maiara—di antara jari tengah dan jari manis. Ia tampaknya terus mencoba mencicipi sesuatu sementara mulutnya mengendur, lalu menghadap Eiri dengan tatapan terbuka. “Maafkan saya, king-maid, tapi indra saya sedang kacau.” Ucapannya yang sedih tidak secepat rap seperti biasanya, lebih seperti G-funk.

085225c1b549.en: Four steps away, three, two—Harry felt like his knife was getting close to making contact, but then he saw Maiara’s leg fly through the air, towards his neck, where he did not even feel the pain, or pressure of it making contact—a true roundhouse kick of someone who knows what they were doing.
085225c1b549.t: Empat langkah lagi, tiga, dua—Harry merasa pisaunya hampir mengenai sasaran, tetapi kemudian ia melihat kaki Maiara melayang di udara, ke arah lehernya, di mana ia bahkan tidak merasakan sakit, atau tekanan saat kaki itu mengenainya—tendangan memutar sejati dari seseorang yang tahu apa yang sedang ia lakukan.

099e32a7242b.en: Itagiba, with a relaxed expression, and gleeful smile continued his royally upbeat speech, raising his voice further, to the edge of a scream. “SANBI-EYE OR MAIARA’S HAND! EITHER WAY, HARRY WILL BECOME ONE OF US, AND HELP PROTECT YOU ALL!”
099e32a7242b.t: Itagiba, dengan raut santai, dan senyum gembira, melanjutkan pidato kerajaannya yang penuh semangat, semakin meninggikan suaranya, sampai di ambang berteriak. “SANBI-EYE ATAU TANGAN MAIARA! YANG MANA PUN, HARRY AKAN MENJADI SALAH SATU DARI KITA, DAN MEMBANTU MELINDUNGI KALIAN SEMUA!”

0a2377d3ba3c.en: The crowd cheered once again, but this time the rowdiness and sheer excitement were tamed down. Not that they were less excited per se, but just something about Neferteri’s energy not being as raw as Itagiba’s.
0a2377d3ba3c.t: Kerumunan bersorak sekali lagi, tetapi kali ini keriuhan dan kegembiraan murninya lebih jinak. Bukan berarti mereka kurang bersemangat, hanya saja ada sesuatu pada energi Neferteri yang tidak semurni energi Itagiba.

0a439f7cd89d.en: One of those tiny humanoids flew by his head, then suddenly hovered, halting its forward movement. Waving with a welcoming smile, this tiny humanoid looked like a hostess at a bar—dressed like one too even, including wearing a large belt pouch on the side, which one could assume was for money.
0a439f7cd89d.t: Salah satu humanoid mungil itu terbang melewati kepalanya, lalu tiba-tiba melayang diam, menghentikan gerakan majunya. Melambai dengan senyum menyambut, humanoid mungil ini tampak seperti pramusaji di bar—bahkan berpakaian seperti itu juga, termasuk memakai kantong sabuk besar di samping, yang bisa diduga untuk uang.

0a8a3ca5ed18.en: Harry and Maiara exchanged glances. Harry stood there, still, seeing Maiara take a deep breath, holding her anger from punching him in the face—or feeding her anger by staring at him with an intent to punch him in the face. It was hard to tell, to be honest. She then walked off towards Neferteri, leaving Harry all alone amongst the strangers walking about.
0a8a3ca5ed18.t: Harry dan Maiara saling bertukar pandang. Harry berdiri di sana, diam, melihat Maiara menarik napas dalam-dalam, menahan amarahnya agar tidak meninju wajahnya—atau memberi makan amarahnya dengan menatapnya dengan niat meninju wajahnya. Sejujurnya, sulit dibedakan. Ia lalu berjalan pergi ke arah Neferteri, meninggalkan Harry sendirian di antara orang-orang asing yang berlalu-lalang.

0bd967d889b5.en: Meanwhile, the public’s volume increased, while a bald man of tall stature, wearing blue and black rags, spit on the ground near Harry “So you were a druggy from the slums, huh? Get the fuck out of here! MAIARA! Choose me instead! I GOT BIG DICK ENERGY—!”
0bd967d889b5.t: Sementara itu, suara publik semakin keras, sementara seorang pria botak bertubuh tinggi, mengenakan pakaian compang-camping biru dan hitam, meludah ke tanah di dekat Harry, “Jadi kau pecandu dari permukiman kumuh, ya? Enyah dari sini, bangsat! MAIARA! Pilih aku saja! AKU PUNYA AURA KONTOL GEDE—!”

0e9139000558.en: The passerby looked at Harry, then Itagiba, then touched his finger on the side of his forehead, and then moved it forward, like he was tipping an imaginary hat, and disappeared into the crowd.
0e9139000558.t: Pejalan kaki itu memandang Harry, lalu Itagiba, lalu menyentuhkan jarinya ke samping dahinya, lalu menggerakkannya ke depan, seperti mengangkat topi khayalan, dan menghilang ke dalam kerumunan.

0eddd2b1932c.en: “Get over here! If you stray too far, you will be killed by the guards.” Kibe was a ways forward, glancing back at Harry.
0eddd2b1932c.t: “Ke sini! Kalau kau menyimpang terlalu jauh, kau akan dibunuh para pengawal.” Kibe sudah cukup jauh di depan, menoleh ke Harry.

1075166cbcaa.en: Harry gripped his bloodied blade, but deep inside him the mental picture of stabbing someone clashed against the roaring energy from the crowd that filled his spirit. Harry stood there, quite a few steps away from Maiara, tremblingly holding his knife with one hand, while the other was slumbering on the side, hanging like dead meat on a butcher shop display. Harry’s breath began turning shallower and shallower, until he held his breath, and ran towards her with his knife in front, pointing at her gut. “ARRRHHHHH” He let out a high-pitched scream that sounded more like he was being tortured.
1075166cbcaa.t: Harry mencengkeram bilahnya yang berdarah, tetapi jauh di dalam dirinya, gambaran mental menusuk seseorang berbenturan dengan energi kerumunan yang menderu yang memenuhi jiwanya. Harry berdiri di sana, cukup banyak langkah dari Maiara, memegang pisaunya dengan gemetar dengan satu tangan, sementara tangan yang lain terkulai di samping, tergantung seperti daging mati di etalase toko daging. Napas Harry mulai semakin dangkal dan semakin dangkal, sampai ia menahan napasnya, dan berlari ke arahnya dengan pisau di depan, mengarah ke perutnya. “ARRRHHHHH” Ia mengeluarkan teriakan melengking yang lebih terdengar seperti sedang disiksa.

128dfa27914c.en: What do you—want from me! Harry tried to speak, but his mouth only murmured and gargled nonsense into the pillow. The nonsense turned into a grunt when a newfound pressure began on his neck, not even really hurting this time. Coincidentally, not long after Harry felt like he forgot something. Something important—like someone at his door, knocking for his attention, but he did not expect anyone to stop by today. Ahh—it’s fine. His thoughts began to murk into one another, tethering on the verge of losing consciousness, where life or death are both a step away. Seeing everything black, not even knowing which way is up, kinda reminded him of when he was in the red recliner watching TV, eating tacos and drinking beer. The beer tasted so refreshingly crispy, as if it just came out of a near frozen tap. The tacos were so fresh it appeared the cooker from the taco shop had come to his house and made it especially for him—maybe it was him that knocked at the door? On the TV he saw a greenish light, but then his eyes adjusted, and he suddenly saw a familiar ceiling basked in a green light. Home?
128dfa27914c.t: Apa yang kau—mau dariku! Harry mencoba bicara, tetapi mulutnya hanya menggumamkan dan mendeguk omong kosong ke bantal. Omong kosong itu berubah menjadi erangan ketika tekanan baru mulai terasa di lehernya, bahkan tidak benar-benar sakit kali ini. Kebetulan, tak lama kemudian Harry merasa seperti melupakan sesuatu. Sesuatu yang penting—seperti seseorang di depan pintunya, mengetuk meminta perhatiannya, tetapi ia tidak mengira ada yang akan mampir hari ini. Ahh—tidak apa-apa. Pikiran-pikirannya mulai keruh bercampur satu sama lain, terombang-ambing di ambang kehilangan kesadaran, di mana hidup atau mati sama-sama tinggal selangkah lagi. Melihat semuanya hitam, bahkan tidak tahu ke arah mana atas, agak mengingatkannya pada saat ia di kursi malas merah menonton TV, makan taco dan minum bir. Bir itu terasa begitu segar dan renyah, seolah baru keluar dari keran yang hampir membeku. Taconya begitu segar sampai tampaknya juru masak dari kedai taco datang ke rumahnya dan membuatnya khusus untuknya—mungkin dia yang mengetuk pintu? Di TV ia melihat cahaya kehijauan, tetapi kemudian matanya menyesuaikan diri, dan tiba-tiba ia melihat langit-langit yang familier bermandikan cahaya hijau. Rumah?

1538450529f1.en: The weight of the sword almost broke Harry’s wrist—at least that’s what Harry felt as the sword bent forward, and struck the ground. The intensity of the strike rattled Harry’s bones, almost straining his muscles in the process, while also catching the attention, and laughter of some passersby.
1538450529f1.t: Berat pedang itu hampir mematahkan pergelangan tangan Harry—setidaknya begitulah yang dirasakan Harry saat pedang itu menekuk ke depan, dan menghantam tanah. Kerasnya hantaman itu menggetarkan tulang-tulang Harry, hampir membuat otot-ototnya tegang dalam prosesnya, sekaligus menarik perhatian, dan tawa, beberapa orang yang lewat.

15a5a52dc2fd.en: The public all seemed to remember something, triggering a bunch of laughter, driving the attention away from Harry, while also leaving him cluelessly out of the conversation.
15a5a52dc2fd.t: Publik semuanya tampak teringat sesuatu, memicu banyak tawa, mengalihkan perhatian dari Harry, sekaligus membuatnya tidak paham apa yang dibicarakan.

161e019b3991.en: Continuing what appeared to be a ritual, Sora smelled her hair, then her neck, upper back, then focused on her arms and hands. She licked Maiara right in the space between her middle and ring fingers, and tasted the result like she was enjoying the plate of prosciutto, all before returning to smell her chest and face. Turning to Kibe, she shook her head as she once again grasped her maid skirt—while not even managing to make eye contact, of course.
161e019b3991.t: Melanjutkan apa yang tampak seperti ritual, Sora mencium rambutnya, lalu lehernya, punggung atasnya, lalu berfokus pada lengan dan tangannya. Ia menjilat Maiara tepat di celah antara jari tengah dan jari manisnya, dan mencicipi hasilnya seolah sedang menikmati sepiring prosciutto, sebelum kembali mencium dada dan wajahnya. Berbalik ke Kibe, ia menggeleng sambil sekali lagi meremas rok pelayannya—tentu saja tanpa berhasil melakukan kontak mata.

16d5789b21a5.en: The crowd roared. Beer mugs were raised, beer was spilled by some, and the crowd packed closely around this semi-circular-ish space, eager to watch the live event.
16d5789b21a5.t: Kerumunan meraung. Gelas-gelas bir diangkat, bir tumpah dari tangan sebagian orang, dan kerumunan merapat di sekitar ruang yang agak setengah lingkaran ini, tak sabar menonton acara langsung itu.

17de600e1aab.en: Harry, meanwhile, looked around, seeing a mix of facial expressions towards him. Is five hundred that bad? He looked towards Eiri for an answer, but all she provided was a simple slow nod with her thin lips.
17de600e1aab.t: Harry, sementara itu, memandang sekeliling, melihat campuran ekspresi wajah yang ditujukan kepadanya. Apa lima ratus itu seburuk itu? Ia memandang Eiri mencari jawaban, tetapi yang ia berikan hanyalah anggukan pelan sederhana dengan bibirnya yang menipis.

17eed6514e42.en: Harry felt a shiver down his spine, letting out a quick moan when a small, moistly warm thing—coincidentally in the shape of Sora’s tongue—gave him a quick lick in the neck. Breaking the rules, he looked at the perpetrator, mid-tasting something with a tight face—maybe whatever she was tasting was probably over seasoned, at least based on how she seemed to be salivating heavily as her eyes strained. Although, she now kinda looked like a cat having a brain freeze, putting her cutesy tongue out, and shaking her head.
17eed6514e42.t: Harry merasakan getaran menjalari tulang punggungnya, mengeluarkan desahan cepat ketika sesuatu yang kecil, hangat dan lembap—kebetulan berbentuk lidah Sora—menjilat lehernya sekilas. Melanggar aturan, ia memandang si pelaku, yang sedang mencicipi sesuatu dengan wajah tegang—mungkin apa pun yang ia cicipi terlalu banyak bumbunya, setidaknya kalau dilihat dari bagaimana ia tampak mengeluarkan banyak air liur sementara matanya menegang. Walaupun, sekarang ia agak tampak seperti kucing yang kepalanya ngilu karena makan es, menjulurkan lidahnya yang imut, dan menggeleng-geleng.

186eb1aa3f6c.en: A loud gasp came from Harry, trying to breathe in, but a suffocating darkness prevented him from grabbing much air. Whaaaat? Harry was slowly growing spatially aware. He felt like he was dying in the darkness again, but this time he could not see the same light that was zooming around like before—until it suddenly clicked in, and he awakened, trying to breathe again, noticing a weight on his back, and himself being pressured against the bed he was sleeping in.
186eb1aa3f6c.t: Tarikan napas keras keluar dari Harry, yang berusaha menghirup udara, tetapi kegelapan yang menyesakkan mencegahnya mendapatkan banyak udara. Apaaaa? Harry perlahan mulai sadar akan ruang di sekitarnya. Ia merasa seperti sekarat di dalam kegelapan lagi, tetapi kali ini ia tidak bisa melihat cahaya yang sama yang melesat ke sana kemari seperti sebelumnya—sampai tiba-tiba ia tersadar, dan terbangun, berusaha bernapas lagi, menyadari ada beban di punggungnya, dan dirinya ditekan ke ranjang tempat ia tidur.

19900868e3c9.en: Chapter VI - Fate · Vol 1 - Failed Experiment · #HusbandOutWorld
19900868e3c9.t: Bab VI - Takdir · Jilid 1 - Eksperimen Gagal · #HusbandOutWorld

19a6c55b191e.en: Harry, resting against the softness of the bed sheets, looked at this male figure, wearing a black long-sleeved undershirt that contrasted with a blue and gold sleeveless thin sweater. Vaguely looking towards this male figure, he finally remembered who he was, specifically when Sora spoke after him during dinner. “K—ibe?”
19a6c55b191e.t: Harry, bersandar pada kelembutan seprai, memandang sosok pria ini, yang mengenakan kaus dalam hitam berlengan panjang yang kontras dengan sweter tipis tanpa lengan berwarna biru dan emas. Memandang samar sosok pria ini, ia akhirnya ingat siapa dia, terutama ketika Sora berbicara sesudahnya saat makan malam. “K—ibe?”

1b0c20d27e00.en: Without waiting for Sora to finish, Maiara crouched down as she closed her eyes, keeping her hands wide to the side.
1b0c20d27e00.t: Tanpa menunggu Sora selesai, Maiara berjongkok sambil memejamkan matanya, menjaga tangannya tetap terentang lebar ke samping.

1b24a01586ea.en: “If Maiara says it’s fine.” Itagiba raised his bottle, then proceeded to suck on it again, while Neferteri did a slow nod, raising her badge.
1b24a01586ea.t: “Kalau Maiara bilang tidak apa-apa.” Itagiba mengangkat botolnya, lalu kembali mengisapnya, sementara Neferteri mengangguk perlahan, mengangkat lencananya.

1df48e34b60c.en: Eiri glanced towards Neferteri, and saw her sipping on a fine wine. Eiri drew a long breath, and looked back at Harry. “Go Harry! Go Harry!” She chanted alongside everyone else.
1df48e34b60c.t: Eiri melirik ke arah Neferteri, dan melihatnya menyesap anggur yang bagus. Eiri menarik napas panjang, dan kembali memandang Harry. “Ayo Harry! Ayo Harry!” Ia ikut bersorak bersama semua orang.

2194ce023eee.en: “Rrruuugggghhh” The humanoid made a low cat-like purr, mixed with a lion grunt, looking down on Harry.
2194ce023eee.t: “Rrruuugggghhh” Humanoid itu mengeluarkan dengkur rendah seperti kucing, bercampur dengusan singa, memandang Harry dari atas.

23509c3d38a6.en: Just like a loud clap, everything became nothingness. Harry felt like his body had melted away, leaving him the sensation that he was in a dark void, with no center, or escape.
23509c3d38a6.t: Persis seperti tepukan keras, segalanya menjadi kehampaan. Harry merasa tubuhnya meleleh, meninggalkannya dengan sensasi bahwa ia berada di kehampaan yang gelap, tanpa pusat, atau jalan keluar.

23b5e83a8947.en: A nervous smile came out of Harry, feeling some of his tension being levitated away by the rather fatherly, or at least uncle-like spirit oozing from Itagiba. He brought the sword closer to view, and saw the words “Sanbi Royal” carved in red in the cyan blade. The sword looked real—it felt real.
23b5e83a8947.t: Senyum gugup muncul dari Harry, merasakan sebagian ketegangannya terangkat oleh semangat kebapakan, atau setidaknya semangat ala paman, yang terpancar dari Itagiba. Ia mendekatkan pedang itu untuk dilihat, dan melihat kata-kata “Sanbi Royal” terukir merah di bilah sian. Pedang itu tampak nyata—terasa nyata.

23c8cdd59470.en: Harry went to open the door, but he paused instead. Looking for a way out, he glanced towards the drawers, remembering when Eiri pulled a towel out of one. Luckily for him, there were a few, so he wrapped one of them on his lower back, and made his way back to the bedroom, where Kibe was still at the door, facing the stairs. Harry, by reflex, smiled slightly as they made eye contact. He really does not sound happy.
23c8cdd59470.t: Harry hendak membuka pintu, tetapi ia malah berhenti. Mencari jalan keluar, ia melirik ke arah laci-laci, teringat saat Eiri mengeluarkan handuk dari salah satunya. Untungnya, ada beberapa, jadi ia melilitkan salah satunya di pinggang bawahnya, dan kembali ke kamar tidur, tempat Kibe masih berdiri di pintu, menghadap tangga. Harry, secara refleks, sedikit tersenyum saat mata mereka bertemu. Dia benar-benar tidak terdengar senang.

26a1ccf03be8.en: Harry slightly furrowed his brow. But I am not from the slums, right? He glanced towards Eiri, but she was busy attending to Sora.
26a1ccf03be8.t: Harry sedikit mengerutkan dahi. Tapi aku bukan dari permukiman kumuh, kan? Ia melirik ke arah Eiri, tetapi Eiri sibuk mengurus Sora.

2781915256c2.en: Itagiba raised his badge, making the thudding stop. “Y’ALL READY?”
2781915256c2.t: Itagiba mengangkat lencananya, menghentikan bunyi debam itu. “KALIAN SIAP?”

2947df839605.en: “—Hence, we created this event ruled by a customized Gandew Duel. Death will not determine the loser, but rather the inability to defend one’s position. All other rules shall remain original to its nature.” Neferteri lowered her badge, and looked towards Kibe, giving a nod.
2947df839605.t: “—Karena itu, kami menciptakan acara ini yang diatur oleh Duel Gandew yang disesuaikan. Kematian tidak akan menentukan siapa yang kalah, melainkan ketidakmampuan untuk mempertahankan posisi. Semua aturan lainnya tetap sesuai dengan aslinya.” Neferteri menurunkan lencananya, dan memandang Kibe, memberi anggukan.

29cd1e9cd215.en: Harry’s hands now felt like touching her badge—amongst other things of hers, but that was just one of the thoughts rushing through his mind at the moment as everything felt so foreign.
29cd1e9cd215.t: Tangan Harry kini ingin menyentuh lencananya—di antara hal-hal lain miliknya, tetapi itu hanya salah satu pikiran yang berkelebat di benaknya saat itu karena segalanya terasa begitu asing.

29da659c7dbc.en: Avoiding eye contact, Sora approached him. “Excuse me, sir Harry—” She crouched, and began sniffing him up the same way as Maiara, including the same private-smelling course of action—which made him tense up as he sometimes could feel her puffs of air—also her cutesy face looking like she was about to give head probably did not help his wildly wavering mental status.
29da659c7dbc.t: Menghindari kontak mata, Sora mendekatinya. “Permisi, Tuan Harry—” Ia berjongkok, dan mulai mengendusnya dengan cara yang sama seperti Maiara, termasuk prosedur mencium kemaluan yang sama—yang membuatnya tegang karena kadang ia bisa merasakan embusan napasnya—juga wajahnya yang imut, yang tampak seperti akan melakukan oral, mungkin tidak membantu kondisi mentalnya yang bergoyang liar.

2a32852d5dce.en: The Sanbi royals, watching over the duel, didn’t seem too keen to celebrate either, except for Nina, the small pink princess. Her hands were up in the air as she ran towards the food and candy stands, only to have Neferteri tell a nearby maid to watch over her. Eori kept to herself, seemingly silently enjoying the party.
2a32852d5dce.t: Para Sanbi royal, yang mengawasi duel itu, tampaknya juga tidak terlalu ingin berpesta, kecuali Nina, si putri kecil berbaju merah muda. Tangannya terangkat ke udara saat ia berlari ke kios-kios makanan dan permen, hanya untuk membuat Neferteri menyuruh seorang pelayan di dekatnya mengawasinya. Eori menyendiri, tampaknya diam-diam menikmati pesta itu.

2c3b33b98364.en: “FUCK! That took a while.” Now an angrier voice came from whoever was pinning down Harry, releasing him from a death by suffocation. A nice pop sound came next, sounding awfully similar to when Eiri had popped the nari gel open.
2c3b33b98364.t: “BANGSAT! Lama juga.” Kini suara yang lebih marah datang dari siapa pun yang mengunci Harry, melepaskannya dari kematian karena sesak napas. Bunyi pop yang enak menyusul, terdengar sangat mirip dengan saat Eiri membuka nari gel tadi.

2dd765cf4051.en: The audience celebrated. “Owwww! Game is on!” A random person screamed out loud amongst the cheers.
2dd765cf4051.t: Penonton bersorak. “Owwww! Pertandingan dimulai!” Seseorang berteriak keras di tengah sorakan.

2e3eab537f3c.en: “Who are you?” The girl placed her hand on his neck, ready to suffocate him, as the rest of her naked body lay on top of him.
2e3eab537f3c.t: “Kau siapa?” Gadis itu meletakkan tangannya di leher Harry, siap mencekiknya, sementara sisa tubuhnya yang telanjang berbaring di atasnya.

2ed1804594cf.en: Chapter VI subchapter 1: in a dark green-lit room, a green-skinned figure looms over a dark-haired person lying below.
2ed1804594cf.t: Bab VI subbab 1: di ruangan gelap yang diterangi cahaya hijau, sosok berkulit hijau membayangi seseorang berambut gelap yang terbaring di bawahnya.

30f1f7a42405.en: What check? Harry felt ticklish inside his mind, dumping more curiosity, with a hint of sexual drive to the swirling pools of emotions within him.
30f1f7a42405.t: Pemeriksaan apa? Harry merasakan geli di dalam pikirannya, menumpahkan lebih banyak rasa penasaran, dengan sedikit dorongan seksual, ke dalam kolam emosi yang berputar di dalam dirinya.

31d79ac129f4.en: Harry looked at his hand. A green wooden badge, about the size of a credit card, just like Eiri’s, now rested on his hands, but this time the name Harry Sanbi was carved instead. A faint smell came from it, and when Harry sniffed it closer, he could smell burnt wood—revealing just how fresh the badge was. “It’s my badge!” Harry held the badge with both hands, feeling a piece of himself in this world as the heavy door began to creak open towards them.
31d79ac129f4.t: Harry memandang tangannya. Sebuah lencana kayu hijau, kira-kira seukuran kartu kredit, persis seperti milik Eiri, kini berada di tangannya, tetapi kali ini nama Harry Sanbi yang terukir. Bau samar keluar darinya, dan ketika Harry mengendusnya lebih dekat, ia bisa mencium bau kayu terbakar—memperlihatkan betapa barunya lencana itu. “Ini lencanaku!” Harry memegang lencana itu dengan kedua tangan, merasakan sepotong dirinya di dunia ini saat pintu yang berat itu mulai berderit terbuka ke arah mereka.

31eaf366c0c6.en: There’s a lot of people here. Harry’s eyes saw a sea of skin colors and body sizes. Humans, some skinny, some muscly, and some even thick, or EXTRA THICC as some would put it. This wide spectrum also applied to humanoids ranging from tiny, baby-size versions of Sora to inhumanly tall and strong versions of Sora—about as strong as an orc too. So that’s what Sorefaries, Wozefaries, and Darfaries look like. Harry noticed the size of the canine teeth poking out did change according to how big or small they were, just like the book he had glanced over yesterday. The same book also had a detailed examination of the entrails on the next page—which looked just like any other human on the inside. Harry tried to kill that gross thought, concentrating back in the real world.
31eaf366c0c6.t: Banyak sekali orang di sini. Mata Harry melihat lautan warna kulit dan ukuran tubuh. Manusia, ada yang kurus, ada yang berotot, dan bahkan ada yang tebal, atau EXTRA THICC seperti kata sebagian orang. Spektrum yang luas ini juga berlaku untuk humanoid, mulai dari versi Sora yang mungil seukuran bayi sampai versi Sora yang tinggi dan kuat secara tidak manusiawi—kira-kira sekuat orc juga. Jadi begitu rupa Sorefaries, Wozefaries, dan Darfaries. Harry memperhatikan ukuran gigi taring yang menyembul memang berubah sesuai besar atau kecilnya mereka, persis seperti buku yang ia lirik kemarin. Buku yang sama juga punya pemeriksaan terperinci tentang isi perut di halaman berikutnya—yang tampak persis seperti manusia lain di bagian dalamnya. Harry berusaha membunuh pikiran menjijikkan itu, kembali berkonsentrasi pada dunia nyata.

320e27396add.en: “Now this is some good shit. Have you seen it before? Of course you haven’t.” Itagiba did not even let Harry say a word before he tilted the shield-looking artifact so Harry could see the front, where it would be flush with someone’s wrist when worn, “It’s like a shield, but you wear it on your wrist.”
320e27396add.t: “Nah, ini baru barang bagus. Kau pernah lihat sebelumnya? Tentu saja belum.” Itagiba bahkan tidak membiarkan Harry mengucapkan sepatah kata pun sebelum ia memiringkan artefak mirip perisai itu agar Harry bisa melihat bagian depannya, yang akan sejajar dengan pergelangan tangan seseorang saat dipakai, “Ini seperti perisai, tapi dipakai di pergelangan tangan.”

326d11ec36ac.en: “Yo! Harry! Get in the center!” Stopping suckling his beer like it was a baby bottle, Itagiba waved his hand towards the big circular-ish open area in front of them.
326d11ec36ac.t: “Yo! Harry! Ke tengah sana!” Berhenti mengisap birnya seolah itu botol susu bayi, Itagiba melambaikan tangannya ke arah area terbuka besar yang agak melingkar di depan mereka.

338ae9ea74ae.en: Harry, slowly moving his eyes down to the perpetrator, saw a familiar girly figure with long purple hair, her perky breasts had tantalizing nipples, deliriously calling for someone to suck them. Her wide vicious grin, like a hyena about to kill its prey, shone in the green moonlight. He saw her before, but just could not register who it was even though her face was clearly visible in the green moonshine. The girl spoke something unintelligible towards him, then slapped him in the face. He could not even feel the slap as he saw her vicious pink eyes staring at him. He then felt a pressure on his neck that intensified with each passing second. He gargled, and murmured unintelligible groans in response. Suddenly, he saw her licking her hand, and then moving it between her thighs, adjusting herself towards him, where she began to stroke her hips on his mouth and nose. He saw her tastefully play with her erect nipples in the bask of the green moonlight; at least for a bit as somehow the room was growing darker, and darker.
338ae9ea74ae.t: Harry, perlahan menurunkan pandangannya ke pelaku, melihat sosok gadis yang familier dengan rambut ungu panjang, payudaranya yang montok memiliki puting yang menggoda, seolah mendesak untuk diisap. Senyumnya yang lebar dan ganas, seperti hyena yang akan membunuh mangsanya, bersinar di bawah cahaya bulan hijau. Dia pernah melihatnya sebelumnya, tapi sama sekali tidak bisa mengenali siapa itu meskipun wajahnya jelas terlihat di sinar bulan hijau. Gadis itu mengucapkan sesuatu yang tidak jelas kepadanya, lalu menampar wajahnya. Dia bahkan tidak merasakan tamparan itu saat melihat mata merah mudanya yang ganas menatapnya. Kemudian dia merasakan tekanan di lehernya yang semakin intens setiap detiknya. Dia bergumam, dan mengeluarkan erangan tidak jelas sebagai respons. Tiba-tiba, dia melihatnya menjilat tangannya, lalu menggerakkannya di antara pahanya, menyesuaikan dirinya ke arah Harry, di mana dia mulai menggesekkan pinggulnya ke mulut dan hidungnya. Dia melihatnya bermain dengan putingnya yang tegang di bawah sinar bulan hijau; setidaknya sebentar karena entah bagaimana ruangan menjadi semakin gelap, dan lebih gelap.

33ba9d9c07f7.en: “Uhhh—no?” Harry raised the shortsword, and the strapped shield. “I don’t think I ever fought before.”
33ba9d9c07f7.t: “Uhhh—tidak?” Harry mengangkat pedang pendek itu, dan perisai yang terikat. “Kurasa aku belum pernah bertarung sebelumnya.”

33be188127ae.en: A Darfaries, a humanoid race nearly twice as tall as humans, spoke after, in a firm and deeper tone, almost like an orc grunt. “No, you stupid Brunto! The king hasn’t shown up in ages. He’s gonna find where new Sanbi fishing spots are!”
33be188127ae.t: Seorang Darfaries, ras humanoid yang tingginya hampir dua kali manusia, berbicara sesudahnya, dengan nada tegas dan lebih berat, hampir seperti dengusan orc. “Bukan, dasar Brunto bodoh! Raja sudah lama sekali tidak muncul. Dia akan mencari di mana tempat-tempat memancing Sanbi yang baru!”

34f5ca15a0c4.en: Harry watched the ritual unfold alongside the eagerly anticipating audience. That’s weird. Is she trying to find something? Harry noticed how Sora’s small nose was wide open, taking small, quick breaths pretty close to Maiara’s skin, sometimes even tasting the air as well. Harry’s mind felt something familiar about it, like he had seen this before, but somehow a human, or at least a humanoid figure doing it seemed off. Until suddenly his mind struck gold—well, more like pyrite, but it was better than nothing now that he had a faint recollection of his family dog sniffing the large taco on his hand—or perhaps it was his hand that was child size, and made the taco look big. Haven’t seen any dogs around either—I thought they were more common.
34f5ca15a0c4.t: Harry menonton ritual itu berlangsung bersama penonton yang menunggu dengan penuh semangat. Aneh. Apa dia sedang mencari sesuatu? Harry memperhatikan bagaimana hidung kecil Sora terbuka lebar, mengambil napas-napas kecil yang cepat sangat dekat dengan kulit Maiara, kadang bahkan mencicipi udara juga. Pikiran Harry merasakan sesuatu yang familier tentang hal itu, seperti ia pernah melihatnya sebelumnya, tetapi entah bagaimana manusia, atau setidaknya sosok humanoid, yang melakukannya terasa janggal. Sampai tiba-tiba pikirannya menemukan emas—yah, lebih seperti pirit, tetapi lebih baik daripada tidak ada sekarang setelah ia punya ingatan samar tentang anjing keluarganya yang mengendus taco besar di tangannya—atau mungkin tangannya yang seukuran tangan anak kecil, dan membuat taconya tampak besar. Aku juga belum melihat anjing di sekitar sini—kukira anjing lebih umum.

373924ea8f85.en: Maiara, a not-so-girly woman, dropped her hammer, and posed ready to defend with her fists, as if the bell of a boxing match was about to strike. She bit her lips, concentrating on her only enemy.
373924ea8f85.t: Maiara, wanita yang tidak terlalu feminin, menjatuhkan palunya, dan berpose siap bertahan dengan kepalan tangannya, seolah bel pertandingan tinju akan berbunyi. Ia menggigit bibirnya, berkonsentrasi pada satu-satunya musuhnya.

37831234cf5b.en: The passerby narrowed his eyes. “You really think so? He doesn’t look agile enough to be using that.” He pointed his head towards the short sword Harry was carrying.
37831234cf5b.t: Pejalan kaki itu menyipitkan mata. “Kau benar-benar berpikir begitu? Dia tidak kelihatan cukup gesit untuk memakai itu.” Ia menunjuk dengan kepalanya ke arah pedang pendek yang dibawa Harry.

3acb62b5d14c.en: The crowd turned their attention to Harry. Meanwhile, Harry stood there, shakily holding his badge, sweating nervously as the curious eyeballs of everyone around apparently all waited for him to do something.
3acb62b5d14c.t: Kerumunan mengalihkan perhatian mereka ke Harry. Sementara itu, Harry berdiri di sana, memegang lencananya dengan gemetar, berkeringat gugup sementara mata-mata penasaran semua orang di sekitarnya tampaknya menunggunya melakukan sesuatu.

3ace8d5e7aa5.en: Harry’s arms and legs felt slightly sore, as if he had done a bit too much elliptical. He looked at Kibe, still not saying anything as they reached the first floor. “Where are we going to duel?”
3ace8d5e7aa5.t: Lengan dan kaki Harry terasa agak pegal, seolah ia terlalu banyak memakai mesin elips. Ia memandang Kibe, yang masih tidak mengatakan apa-apa saat mereka sampai di lantai satu. “Kita akan berduel di mana?”

3d5f2da3c14c.en: Hearing Eiri’s voice above the background, Harry felt the throbbing pain wane, and his heart raced once again. This energy blowing up from within cleared his lungs enough for him to take deeper, but still hasty breaths. He leaned forward and took a few wobbly steps towards the shortsword he had dropped, leaving a trail of blood contrasting the rocky gray ground. He picked up his shortsword with his bloodied right hand, staining its cyan shiny appeal.
3d5f2da3c14c.t: Mendengar suara Eiri di atas suara latar, Harry merasakan rasa sakit yang berdenyut itu mereda, dan jantungnya berpacu sekali lagi. Energi yang meledak dari dalam dirinya ini melegakan paru-parunya cukup untuk membuatnya bisa menarik napas lebih dalam, meski masih tergesa-gesa. Ia mencondongkan tubuh ke depan dan mengambil beberapa langkah sempoyongan ke arah pedang pendek yang tadi ia jatuhkan, meninggalkan jejak darah yang kontras dengan tanah berbatu yang kelabu. Ia mengambil pedang pendeknya dengan tangan kanannya yang berdarah, menodai kilau sian yang memikat itu.

3f6522a1e1a3.en: Harry’s eyes could not stop noticing the number of blue tickets he saw people carrying, alongside beer and snacks. The same purple meat he had eaten yesterday at dinnertime now was offered in thighs or kebab style in the hands of some of the people he saw around him, with some others also carrying beer mugs and other snacks. Everyone seemed to be having a good time, as if they were in a stadium watching football, while he felt the thuds chill him to his bones.
3f6522a1e1a3.t: Mata Harry tidak bisa berhenti memperhatikan banyaknya tiket biru yang ia lihat dibawa orang-orang, bersama bir dan camilan. Daging ungu yang sama yang ia makan kemarin saat makan malam kini ditawarkan dalam bentuk paha atau gaya kebab di tangan sebagian orang yang ia lihat di sekitarnya, dengan yang lain juga membawa gelas bir dan camilan lainnya. Semua orang tampak bersenang-senang, seolah mereka berada di stadion menonton sepak bola, sementara ia merasakan bunyi debam itu membuatnya menggigil sampai ke tulang.

407687ce365d.en: “You forgot your clothes! And fix your hair too!” Kibe spoke loudly, ensuring Harry would hear across the bathroom door.
407687ce365d.t: “Kau lupa pakaianmu! Dan rapikan rambutmu juga!” Kibe berbicara keras, memastikan Harry bisa mendengarnya dari balik pintu kamar mandi.

40d965ba9c45.en: “I’m—sorry.” Still following Kibe’s footsteps, Harry looked back to the humanoid—or more like alligator-noid—with a mix of shrug and surrender. His face held back fear as he heard another grunt, but this time sounding more tame than before. As he passed by a fountain, towards an open area, Harry sighed in relief after finally seeing a few familiar faces: Sora, Eiri, Neferteri, Itagiba, and others.
40d965ba9c45.t: “Aku—minta maaf.” Masih mengikuti langkah Kibe, Harry menoleh ke humanoid itu—atau lebih tepatnya aligator-noid—dengan campuran angkat bahu dan menyerah. Wajahnya menahan rasa takut saat ia mendengar dengusan lagi, tetapi kali ini terdengar lebih jinak dari sebelumnya. Saat melewati air mancur, menuju area terbuka, Harry menghela napas lega setelah akhirnya melihat beberapa wajah yang familier: Sora, Eiri, Neferteri, Itagiba, dan yang lain.

41044c036cb4.en: “You better get fucking ready, you Nari worm!” Maiara showed her grin, taking back steps from Harry while maintaining a strong, firm eye-contact.
41044c036cb4.t: “Lebih baik kau bersiap, bangsat, dasar cacing Nari!” Maiara memperlihatkan seringainya, melangkah mundur dari Harry sambil mempertahankan kontak mata yang kuat dan tegas.

411927554dc2.en: Kibe did not smile back; he just looked back to the stairs. “Get it over with.”
411927554dc2.t: Kibe tidak membalas senyumnya; ia hanya kembali memandang tangga. “Cepat selesaikan.”

43082634f617.en: “Good. So, now let’s go over the basics. A dice will be thrown, and if it lands on the color you choose, you make a single attack.” Itagiba threw his arms as if he was doing a down swipe attack. He then defended himself, throwing his muscly arm out in front, and bending back to take the brunt of an imaginary attack. “Otherwise you defend. The catch is that you can’t evade, or you will automatically lose. You have to take the brunt of the attack.”
43082634f617.t: “Bagus. Jadi, sekarang kita bahas dasar-dasarnya. Sebuah dadu akan dilempar, dan kalau dadunya jatuh di warna yang kau pilih, kau melakukan satu serangan.” Itagiba mengayunkan lengannya seolah sedang melakukan serangan sabetan ke bawah. Lalu ia bertahan, menjulurkan lengannya yang berotot ke depan, dan membungkuk ke belakang untuk menahan beban serangan khayalan. “Kalau tidak, kau bertahan. Masalahnya, kau tidak boleh menghindar, atau kau otomatis kalah. Kau harus menahan beban serangannya.”

470a12a313d3.en: The alligator humanoid crouched down, and helped him sit up, only to hear him grunt in pain as his left arm, still tied to the shield on his forearm, happened to move slightly on its own all over—in ways a break dancer would only dream of.
470a12a313d3.t: Humanoid aligator itu berjongkok, dan membantunya duduk, hanya untuk mendengarnya mengerang kesakitan saat lengan kirinya, yang masih terikat pada perisai di lengan bawahnya, kebetulan bergerak sedikit sendiri ke mana-mana—dengan cara yang hanya bisa diimpikan seorang penari break dance.

482ff371d411.en: Harry, following Kibe’s step without a hitch, stepped out of the castle walls, towards the outside world into what appeared a large roundabout in front of him, with a large fountain decorating the middle. In that fountain stood another large Sanbi fish, but this time in the form of a statue.
482ff371d411.t: Harry, mengikuti langkah Kibe tanpa hambatan, melangkah keluar dari tembok kastil, menuju dunia luar ke sesuatu yang tampak seperti bundaran besar di depannya, dengan air mancur besar menghiasi tengahnya. Di air mancur itu berdiri ikan Sanbi besar lainnya, tetapi kali ini dalam bentuk patung.

4af4fca304fc.en: The passerby looked at the royal vibe oozing from Itagiba, specifically how his sapphire crusted gems on his neck shone in the sun. “I already placed my bet.” The passerby took out a blue ticket from within his pocket.
4af4fca304fc.t: Pejalan kaki itu memandang aura kerajaan yang terpancar dari Itagiba, khususnya bagaimana permata bertatahkan safir di lehernya berkilauan di bawah matahari. “Aku sudah memasang taruhanku.” Pejalan kaki itu mengeluarkan tiket biru dari dalam sakunya.

4cda4347a8a8.en: Dave, the stranger with apparently big dick energy, was now silently huffing under his own breath, crossing his arms as if someone chopped off his energy source.
4cda4347a8a8.t: Dave, orang asing yang katanya punya aura kontol gede itu, kini mendengus diam-diam, menyilangkan tangannya seolah seseorang memotong sumber energinya.

4d19cb2d5de3.en: “He looks normal—what would he have injected on his neck?” Harry heard a guy in green clothes, standing close by speaking out loud.
4d19cb2d5de3.t: “Dia kelihatan normal—apa yang mungkin dia suntikkan di lehernya?” Harry mendengar seorang pria berpakaian hijau, yang berdiri di dekatnya, berbicara keras-keras.

4e10c2ff144d.en: The sound of hinges screaming as they made their best to keep the heavy door afloat echoed everywhere. Two guards appeared, each pushing a side of the door with all their might. Their clothing had a darker blue accent to them, with fish leather texture on both the tank-top-like shirt and helmet. The clothing overall looked light, agile, while the helmet had extra protection, with a dark stripe around the eyes—likely to block off excess sun. As a choice of style over function, the helmet also had a large blue Mohawk, similar to ancient Roman helmets, but more like a dollar store rip-off version of it. On the front, they carried two small knives, and a fanny pack. On the back, they carried a bow and quivers. The bow also had a receptacle just below where the arrow was strung, coincidentally for something just about the size of a nari gel—possibly where arrows would get dipped right before drawing the bow.
4e10c2ff144d.t: Bunyi engsel yang menjerit saat berusaha sebaik mungkin menahan pintu yang berat itu menggema di mana-mana. Dua pengawal muncul, masing-masing mendorong satu sisi pintu dengan sekuat tenaga. Pakaian mereka beraksen biru yang lebih gelap, dengan tekstur kulit ikan pada baju mirip kaus tanpa lengan dan helmnya. Pakaian itu secara keseluruhan tampak ringan, gesit, sementara helmnya punya perlindungan ekstra, dengan garis gelap di sekitar mata—mungkin untuk menghalangi silau matahari. Sebagai pilihan gaya ketimbang fungsi, helm itu juga punya jambul Mohawk biru yang besar, mirip helm Romawi kuno, tetapi lebih seperti versi tiruan murahan dari toko serba ada. Di bagian depan, mereka membawa dua pisau kecil, dan tas pinggang. Di bagian belakang, mereka membawa busur dan tabung anak panah. Busur itu juga punya wadah tepat di bawah tempat anak panah dipasang, kebetulan untuk sesuatu yang kira-kira seukuran nari gel—mungkin tempat anak panah dicelupkan tepat sebelum busur ditarik.

511dc5c3d42b.en: “Just go check his Darfaries interface already!” Kibe, with his arms crossed, loudly spoke towards the guest star of the dueling show, still in her shell, hiding behind Eiri.
511dc5c3d42b.t: “Periksa saja antarmuka Darfaries-nya!” Kibe, dengan tangan bersilang, berbicara keras ke arah bintang tamu pertunjukan duel itu, yang masih di dalam cangkangnya, bersembunyi di balik Eiri.

51dcbc85abe3.en: The crowd cheered back, starting to move around, including into the open area.
51dcbc85abe3.t: Kerumunan balas bersorak, mulai bergerak ke sana kemari, termasuk ke area terbuka.

531099727690.en: “Nobody fucking asked you, small prick!” Showing him the middle finger, Maiara replied faster than the guy could finish his sentence.
531099727690.t: “Tidak ada yang tanya, kontol kecil!” Mengacungkan jari tengah kepadanya, Maiara menjawab lebih cepat daripada pria itu bisa menyelesaikan kalimatnya.

5385e48eff59.en: Itagiba, the king of Sanbi, let out a small burp before raising his voice against the whispering crowd. “WELCOME MY SANBI FRIENDS!” He spoke as loudly as he could, but not loud enough to strain his voice. Successfully taming the crowds with an energy only a few have, his darker, elite-looking badge written in red ink went high up in the air. The corners had four distinctly colored shiny balls, going from top-right red, blue, green, and finishing with yellow on the top-left. Itagiba rotated his hand around, making sure everyone could see the glimmering red light from the thermometer-like apparatus.
5385e48eff59.t: Itagiba, raja Sanbi, bersendawa kecil sebelum meninggikan suaranya melawan kerumunan yang berbisik-bisik. “SELAMAT DATANG, KAWAN-KAWAN SANBI-KU!” Ia berbicara sekeras mungkin, tetapi tidak cukup keras untuk membuat suaranya serak. Berhasil menjinakkan kerumunan dengan energi yang hanya dimiliki segelintir orang, lencananya yang lebih gelap dan tampak elite yang ditulis dengan tinta merah terangkat tinggi ke udara. Sudut-sudutnya punya empat bola mengilap dengan warna berbeda, mulai dari merah di kanan atas, biru, hijau, dan diakhiri kuning di kiri atas. Itagiba memutar-mutar tangannya, memastikan semua orang bisa melihat cahaya merah berkilauan dari alat mirip termometer itu.

551fd35872ed.en: Someone else close by sharply spoke back, eagerly, and confidently saying, “He’s gonna watch out for THE Sanbi King!” Harry looked towards the voice, and saw a skinny guy, about his height, but far older. His pure white hair showed he was well into retirement—assuming he was not one of those people that only stop working when they literally drop dead.
551fd35872ed.t: Seseorang lain di dekatnya membalas dengan tajam, bersemangat, dan yakin, “Dia akan mengawasi SANG Raja Sanbi!” Harry memandang ke arah suara itu, dan melihat seorang pria kurus, kira-kira setinggi dirinya, tetapi jauh lebih tua. Rambutnya yang putih bersih menunjukkan ia sudah lama pensiun—dengan asumsi ia bukan salah satu orang yang baru berhenti bekerja ketika benar-benar mati di tempat.

568262a0b03b.en: “Lower your badge, you little cunt,” Maiara spoke again through her dangerous grin towards Harry, apparently trying to keep the show on some sort of rails, making her anger now seem less genuine. Perhaps her toothy grinning, grinding teeth, and overall scary expression were more like a “Game on, bitch” type of thing, rather than actual hatred towards Harry.
568262a0b03b.t: “Turunkan lencanamu, dasar memek kecil,” Maiara berbicara lagi melalui seringainya yang berbahaya ke arah Harry, tampaknya berusaha menjaga pertunjukan tetap berada di semacam jalurnya, membuat amarahnya kini tampak kurang tulus. Mungkin seringai bergigi, gigi yang bergemeretak, dan raut menakutkannya secara keseluruhan lebih seperti semacam “Ayo mulai, jalang”, ketimbang kebencian sungguhan terhadap Harry.

57a264a92c19.en: Fainting cheers ensued, with some claps here, some alligator grunts there—nothing to fawn over, but it wasn’t completely silent either—Harry probably needed to invest a few more skill points in public speaking as he seeped the energy away from the crowd that Itagiba had initially infused.
57a264a92c19.t: Sorakan lemah menyusul, dengan beberapa tepuk tangan di sana, beberapa dengusan aligator di situ—tidak ada yang perlu dikagumi, tetapi tidak sepenuhnya sunyi juga—Harry mungkin perlu menginvestasikan beberapa skill point lagi di kemampuan berbicara di depan umum karena ia menyedot habis energi kerumunan yang awalnya ditanamkan Itagiba.

59aa84096597.en: Squeezing the corners of her maid dress, Sora looked down in shame, as if she was a shy girl about to ask a boy for prom in a high school corridor—in front of everyone, of course.
59aa84096597.t: Meremas ujung-ujung gaun pelayannya, Sora menunduk malu, seolah ia gadis pemalu yang akan mengajak seorang anak laki-laki ke prom di lorong SMA—di depan semua orang, tentu saja.

5b2dd1a10f44.en: Harry noticed that the shield had logogram pairs sticking out, all looking awfully similar to the ones on the sigil rings—with one being the same pair of logograms Eiri had used to heal his sliced thumb. Another pair had four parallel lines with a plus logogram, with another stranger pair beside it also composed of two logograms, one of a body with the hands blacked out, and a circle with arrows pointing outward.
5b2dd1a10f44.t: Harry memperhatikan bahwa perisai itu punya pasangan-pasangan logogram yang menonjol, semuanya tampak sangat mirip dengan yang ada di cincin sigil—dengan salah satunya pasangan logogram yang sama yang dipakai Eiri untuk menyembuhkan jempolnya yang teriris. Pasangan lain berupa empat garis sejajar dengan logogram tanda tambah, dengan pasangan lain yang lebih aneh di sampingnya yang juga terdiri dari dua logogram, satu berupa tubuh dengan tangan yang dihitamkan, dan satu lagi lingkaran dengan panah-panah yang menunjuk ke luar.

5d125ce8bf13.en: Now standing between them, Sora quickly hid her badge in the shallow depth of her breasts. Looking ready to speak, Sora’s head appeared as if it was gonna merge with her torso. “If you pardon me, Princess Maiara Sanbi! I need to perform the check—” The embarrassed words barely got out as she spoke as fast as she could, then bowed towards Maiara as if she was apologizing for having to commit the utmost sin of mankind.
5d125ce8bf13.t: Kini berdiri di antara mereka, Sora cepat-cepat menyembunyikan lencananya di kedalaman dangkal payudaranya. Tampak siap berbicara, kepala Sora tampak seolah akan menyatu dengan tubuhnya. “Mohon maaf, Putri Maiara Sanbi! Saya harus melakukan pemeriksaan—” Kata-kata malu itu nyaris tak keluar saat ia berbicara secepat mungkin, lalu membungkuk ke arah Maiara seolah sedang meminta maaf karena harus melakukan dosa terbesar umat manusia.

5d9566945465.en: “Can we just get this—” The bathroom door opened. “Oh—feeling the pressure?” Kibe still held the contract in his hand, holding the bathroom door half-open.
5d9566945465.t: “Bisa kita selesaikan saja—” Pintu kamar mandi terbuka. “Oh—merasa tertekan?” Kibe masih memegang kontrak di tangannya, menahan pintu kamar mandi setengah terbuka.

5dddf1dfaa02.en: “C’mon, Harry! You can do this! Fuck her up the ass!” A random person in the audience crouched by Harry, and offered one of his hands, while the other was tightly holding a bundle of blue tickets.
5dddf1dfaa02.t: “Ayo, Harry! Kau pasti bisa! Entot pantatnya!” Seorang penonton sembarangan berjongkok di dekat Harry, dan mengulurkan salah satu tangannya, sementara tangan yang lain menggenggam erat seikat tiket biru.

5eb6efb6dce9.en: Being precise in her timing, Neferteri continued her speech right as the crowd’s cheering started to die down. “For that, we wanted to select a proper representative, one we can bestow duties for an extended period of time, ensuring he will be able to properly understand your needs, and your life experiences. With that said, I would like to introduce you all to Harry Sanbi.” Neferteri slowly raised her hand towards Harry, with a slight smile tugging the corners of her mouth—remaining as elegant as ever.
5eb6efb6dce9.t: Tepat dalam pengaturan waktunya, Neferteri melanjutkan pidatonya tepat saat sorakan kerumunan mulai mereda. “Untuk itu, kami ingin memilih seorang wakil yang layak, seseorang yang dapat kami beri tugas untuk jangka waktu yang panjang, guna memastikan ia akan mampu memahami kebutuhan kalian, dan pengalaman hidup kalian dengan baik. Dengan demikian, saya ingin memperkenalkan kalian semua kepada Harry Sanbi.” Neferteri perlahan mengangkat tangannya ke arah Harry, dengan sedikit senyum menarik sudut-sudut mulutnya—tetap anggun seperti biasa.

6256fcec5a61.en: Harry looked back at Kibe, holding out with an extended fist, appearing to want to fist bump. Being a fine gentleman, Harry fist bumped him.
6256fcec5a61.t: Harry memandang Kibe, yang mengulurkan kepalan tangannya, tampaknya ingin tos kepalan. Sebagai pria terhormat, Harry membalas tos kepalan itu.

673033b41646.en: Without saying a word, Kibe carefreely walked down the spiral stairs, without even looking back to Harry to ensure he was following him.
673033b41646.t: Tanpa sepatah kata pun, Kibe dengan santai menuruni tangga spiral, tanpa bahkan menoleh ke Harry untuk memastikan ia mengikutinya.

67ef2eed6a62.en: As Harry approached Itagiba, someone of corpulent body size, wearing a straw hat with a red tree accent on it, intervened between them. “Itagiba!” He sounded pretty cheery, if not liquored up as well.
67ef2eed6a62.t: Saat Harry mendekati Itagiba, seseorang bertubuh gemuk, memakai topi jerami dengan aksen pohon merah di atasnya, menyela di antara mereka. “Itagiba!” Ia terdengar cukup ceria, kalau tidak bisa dibilang juga sudah mabuk.

693fae0b13a1.en: We’re here to have fun? Harry looked at Neferteri, coming closer to her husband.
693fae0b13a1.t: Kita di sini untuk bersenang-senang? Harry memandang Neferteri, yang mendekati suaminya.

6aad85f788eb.en: “Sir—please crouch down, extend your arms and close your eyes.” The girly voice coming from within Sora barely got out—her rosacea looked so brightly red that one could fear she was having a high fever.
6aad85f788eb.t: “Tuan—tolong berjongkok, rentangkan tangan Anda dan pejamkan mata.” Suara feminin dari dalam diri Sora nyaris tak keluar—rosacea-nya tampak begitu merah menyala sampai orang bisa khawatir ia sedang demam tinggi.

6cfa73364f41.en: “You do it.” Kibe’s uncaring voice clapped back like a slap.
6cfa73364f41.t: “Ambil sendiri.” Suara Kibe yang acuh tak acuh membalas seperti tamparan.

6d47caffcbf4.en: Meanwhile, the concoction was still spreading throughout his entire body, bringing a cool, refreshing sensation that gave way to a slowly growing numbing, and paralyzing effect all over his body, with the extremities feeling more strongly the initial impact. “Urgh!” He tried to roll his entire body to the side, desperately, but whoever this girl was, she must have known how to pin someone down. At least he was able to bend his neck backward a bit to gather some needed fresh air, but doing so triggered an additional surge of pain from whatever was stabbing him in the neck—like as if he had a neck strain. He groaned, trying to scream with all the might he had “LEMME OUT! LEMME—humpf!”
6d47caffcbf4.t: Sementara itu, ramuan itu masih menyebar ke seluruh tubuhnya, membawa sensasi sejuk yang menyegarkan yang berganti menjadi efek mati rasa dan melumpuhkan yang perlahan menguat di sekujur tubuhnya, dengan ujung-ujung tubuh merasakan dampak awal lebih kuat. “Urgh!” Ia mencoba menggulingkan seluruh tubuhnya ke samping, dengan putus asa, tetapi siapa pun gadis ini, ia pasti tahu cara mengunci seseorang. Setidaknya ia bisa menekuk lehernya sedikit ke belakang untuk menghirup udara segar yang dibutuhkan, tetapi melakukannya memicu lonjakan rasa sakit tambahan dari apa pun yang menusuk lehernya—seolah lehernya terkilir. Ia mengerang, mencoba berteriak sekuat tenaga yang ia punya, “LEPASKAN AKU! LEPAS—humpf!”

6f3637c2e755.en: Chapter VI subchapter 3: a crowded street scene with Harry in his blue uniform among many people and stalls.
6f3637c2e755.t: Bab VI subbab 3: suasana jalanan yang ramai dengan Harry berseragam biru di antara banyak orang dan kios-kios.

6f6d4042d606.en: The king of Sanbi, Itagiba, called Harry over with a wide hand motion as he walked to the side of the table where the weapons were all laid out.
6f6d4042d606.t: Raja Sanbi, Itagiba, memanggil Harry dengan lambaian tangan lebar sambil berjalan ke sisi meja tempat semua senjata dipajang.

7229bf2244d7.en: Appearing from amongst the people on the other side, a familiar, strong-looking lady stomped towards him, with a berserker aura around her. She grinned her teeth like a savage animal, while her knuckles were white from how tight her fist was.
7229bf2244d7.t: Muncul dari antara orang-orang di sisi lain, seorang wanita yang familier dan tampak kuat mengentak-entakkan kaki ke arahnya, dengan aura berserker di sekelilingnya. Ia menyeringai memperlihatkan giginya seperti binatang buas, sementara buku-buku jarinya memutih karena kepalan tangannya begitu erat.

733e7550117c.en: “Good. Hope you win! But remember, the kingdom will win either way, and that’s what really matters.” Itagiba nodded, with his face right up to Harry. “Right, Harry?”
733e7550117c.t: “Bagus. Semoga kau menang! Tapi ingat, kerajaan akan menang yang mana pun hasilnya, dan itulah yang benar-benar penting.” Itagiba mengangguk, dengan wajahnya tepat di depan Harry. “Benar, kan, Harry?”

7a83dbc6f4a5.en: Looking at his badge, slightly shaking in his hands, Harry slowly raised it above his head. The glimmer coming out of the red thermometer-like apparatus only covered a small portion of the thinner bar, but it was nonetheless visible to everyone.
7a83dbc6f4a5.t: Memandang lencananya, yang sedikit gemetar di tangannya, Harry perlahan mengangkatnya di atas kepalanya. Kilau yang keluar dari alat merah mirip termometer itu hanya menutupi sebagian kecil batang yang lebih tipis, tetapi tetap terlihat oleh semua orang.

7b08a082b5ed.en: Harry felt something rhythmically strike him in the face, pressuring him. Wake up. He heard a voice inside his mind, but the voice did not sound like his. This thing, still striking his head, grew in pressure, and intensity. In the middle of what appeared to be a boot up from a deep, but unrestful slumber, his mind slowly grew aware of his surroundings. That was until he suddenly had a flashback to something on top of him, somehow asphyxiating him. With a loud gasp, seeking for air as if he was underwater for five minutes, Harry snapped back into reality.
7b08a082b5ed.t: Harry merasakan sesuatu memukul wajahnya dengan berirama, menekannya. Bangun. Ia mendengar sebuah suara di dalam pikirannya, tetapi suara itu tidak terdengar seperti suaranya. Benda ini, yang masih memukul kepalanya, semakin kuat tekanan dan intensitasnya. Di tengah apa yang tampak seperti proses menyala kembali dari tidur yang dalam, tetapi tidak nyenyak, pikirannya perlahan menyadari sekelilingnya. Sampai tiba-tiba ia mendapat kilas balik tentang sesuatu di atasnya, entah bagaimana mencekiknya. Dengan tarikan napas keras, mencari udara seolah ia berada di bawah air selama lima menit, Harry tersentak kembali ke kenyataan.

7b2b9ad24fee.en: A hum came out of Kibe, sizing Harry up and down from his back.
7b2b9ad24fee.t: Gumaman keluar dari Kibe, yang menaksir Harry dari atas ke bawah dari belakang.

7bfe7fe563b8.en: Maiara, meanwhile, nodded at the words Neferteri stated, letting through a temporary grinned smile amidst her voracity to combat Harry. There was clearly enjoyment coursing through her anger, imagining doing something to Harry that he himself could not even fathom.
7bfe7fe563b8.t: Maiara, sementara itu, mengangguk mendengar kata-kata yang diucapkan Neferteri, membiarkan senyum menyeringai sesaat muncul di tengah kebuasannya untuk melawan Harry. Jelas ada kenikmatan yang mengalir di balik amarahnya, membayangkan melakukan sesuatu kepada Harry yang bahkan tidak bisa ia bayangkan sendiri.

7d5fe53db84a.en: Maiara gripped her hands on her tribal hammer, showing Harry that its edges looked painfully bone-breaking blunt. Her head bounced to the rhythm of the beat, seemingly concentrating on something as her face looked more serious than angry.
7d5fe53db84a.t: Maiara mencengkeram palu suku-nya, memperlihatkan kepada Harry bahwa tepi-tepinya tampak tumpul dan menyakitkan, siap meremukkan tulang. Kepalanya mengangguk-angguk mengikuti irama ketukan, tampaknya berkonsentrasi pada sesuatu karena wajahnya tampak lebih serius daripada marah.

7e5f11966c24.en: A thinner gentleman, a few steps away, in blue Sanbi scale clothing, spoke back “SHUT UP, DAVE! We all know what you did with the Sanbi heads.”
7e5f11966c24.t: Seorang pria yang lebih kurus, beberapa langkah jauhnya, berpakaian sisik Sanbi biru, membalas, “DIAM, DAVE! Kami semua tahu apa yang kau lakukan dengan kepala-kepala Sanbi itu.”

80f17f00d75b.en: Neferteri cleared her throat, and raised her badge high up, showing to everyone that it had the same bioluminescence as her husband’s, while her badge was the same wood green color as everyone else's, including Harry’s badge. “Yes, my lovely people, this is a new program we are experimenting with to ensure all the needs, specifically the citizens from distant villages, are all heard in an official manner.” Her voice sounded like she was shouting from the top of her lungs, but it did not sound coarse, or strained at all, as if she had a megaphone built-in on her throat.
80f17f00d75b.t: Neferteri berdeham, dan mengangkat lencananya tinggi-tinggi, menunjukkan kepada semua orang bahwa lencana itu memiliki bioluminesensi yang sama seperti milik suaminya, sementara lencananya berwarna hijau kayu yang sama seperti milik semua orang lain, termasuk lencana Harry. “Ya, rakyatku yang tercinta, ini adalah program baru yang sedang kami uji coba untuk memastikan semua kebutuhan, khususnya warga dari desa-desa yang jauh, didengar secara resmi.” Suaranya terdengar seperti berteriak sekuat paru-parunya, tetapi tidak terdengar kasar, atau tegang sama sekali, seolah ia punya pengeras suara bawaan di tenggorokannya.

81c764116e58.en: The roundabout was packed with people, in what appeared to be a street party. They gave way to both Kibe and Harry.
81c764116e58.t: Bundaran itu penuh sesak dengan orang-orang, dalam sesuatu yang tampak seperti pesta jalanan. Mereka memberi jalan bagi Kibe dan Harry.

81c88ee8617a.en: “It’s time, Nefi?” Itagiba looked at her, expecting she would not say a word.
81c88ee8617a.t: “Sudah waktunya, Nefi?” Itagiba memandangnya, sudah menduga ia tidak akan mengucapkan sepatah kata pun.

82478c6e3881.en: “You'll see,” Kibe curtly replied, scratching his neck using the contract as he stepped on a random child’s drawing resting on the floor, with a few crayons hanging by it.
82478c6e3881.t: “Nanti juga kau lihat,” jawab Kibe singkat, menggaruk lehernya dengan kontrak itu sambil menginjak gambar anak kecil sembarangan yang tergeletak di lantai, dengan beberapa krayon tergeletak di dekatnya.

82739ddfac24.en: “Argh.” The gray-haired man grabbed Harry’s hand and slapped whatever he was holding into it. “Don’t lose it!” He turned back towards the door, and cleared his throat. “BY THE ORDER OF KIBE SANBI ROYAL! OPEN THE DOORS!”
82739ddfac24.t: “Argh.” Pria berambut abu-abu itu meraih tangan Harry dan menepukkan apa pun yang ia pegang ke tangannya. “Jangan sampai hilang!” Ia berbalik ke arah pintu, dan berdeham. “ATAS PERINTAH KIBE SANBI ROYAL! BUKA PINTUNYA!”

829e1f8e0cae.en: Fenafo sized up Harry, and patted him on the shoulder. “Uffda—good luck boy!” He walked closer to Itagiba, and said something in his ear.
829e1f8e0cae.t: Fenafo menaksir Harry, dan menepuk bahunya. “Uffda—semoga beruntung, Nak!” Ia mendekati Itagiba, dan membisikkan sesuatu di telinganya.

8367217d65df.en: Harry felt his tactile senses come back. His face was warm, and he felt a tingle on his forehead. He tried to move his left arm, but it did not respond to him. His left shoulder did, and it was in the form of an excruciating pain, as if someone had shoved a knife on it. He tried to stand up, but only cried out in pain instead.
8367217d65df.t: Harry merasakan indra perabanya kembali. Wajahnya hangat, dan ia merasakan kesemutan di dahinya. Ia mencoba menggerakkan lengan kirinya, tetapi lengan itu tidak merespons. Bahu kirinya merespons, dalam bentuk rasa sakit yang luar biasa, seolah seseorang menancapkan pisau di sana. Ia mencoba berdiri, tetapi malah berteriak kesakitan.

8706b48d6cc0.en: “Yo! Fenafo! Long time no see! Enjoying the party?” Itagiba shook hands with the man, which then turned into a hug with a slap in the back.
8706b48d6cc0.t: “Yo! Fenafo! Lama tidak ketemu! Menikmati pestanya?” Itagiba berjabat tangan dengan pria itu, yang kemudian berubah menjadi pelukan dengan tepukan di punggung.

8780b3c3c13e.en: “YES! Check this shit out!” Itagiba held up a square-looking artifact with spikes on the front.
8780b3c3c13e.t: “YA! Lihat barang ini!” Itagiba mengangkat sebuah artefak berbentuk persegi dengan paku-paku di bagian depannya.

87ad86857612.en: “Just get it over with.” Maiara placed her feet evenly spaced apart and her hands straight out to the sides, while her angered face shifted into an eye-rolling one.
87ad86857612.t: “Cepat selesaikan saja.” Maiara menempatkan kakinya dengan jarak yang sama dan tangannya lurus ke samping, sementara wajahnya yang marah berubah menjadi wajah yang memutar bola mata.

88e17f2f1819.en: “Agrhrhh—It hurts! It hurts! I want to go home!” Tears streamed down Harry’s face, throbbing stabbing pain that was so intense he could barely breathe. With his right hand, he cleaned away the blood and tears of his face, only to see that his entire hand was a vivid red, dripping blood in his tight clothes. His sense of smell and taste came back as well, confirming the metallic notes of his own blood, constantly rolling down on his face.
88e17f2f1819.t: “Agrhrhh—Sakit! Sakit! Aku mau pulang!” Air mata mengalir di wajah Harry, rasa sakit yang berdenyut dan menusuk begitu hebat sampai ia nyaris tidak bisa bernapas. Dengan tangan kanannya, ia menyeka darah dan air mata dari wajahnya, hanya untuk melihat bahwa seluruh tangannya merah menyala, meneteskan darah ke pakaiannya yang ketat. Indra penciuman dan perasanya juga kembali, memastikan nuansa logam dari darahnya sendiri, yang terus mengalir di wajahnya.

8a20cbc3e4ba.en: “Gimme your arm.” Itagiba unbuttoned the strap inside the shield and started strapping firmly on Harry’s left forearm. “All right, Harry. You know what to do with these, right?”
8a20cbc3e4ba.t: “Sini lenganmu.” Itagiba membuka kancing tali di dalam perisai itu dan mulai mengikatnya erat-erat di lengan bawah kiri Harry. “Baiklah, Harry. Kau tahu apa yang harus dilakukan dengan ini, kan?”

8b7b18a61509.en: “Yes—I’m Kibe. Now go get dressed! Everyone is waiting, and I’m not gonna get blamed for it!” Kibe, not exactly looking entertained, pointed the rolled up bloodied contract towards the bathroom.
8b7b18a61509.t: “Ya—aku Kibe. Sekarang cepat berpakaian! Semua orang menunggu, dan aku tidak mau disalahkan karenanya!” Kibe, yang tidak tampak senang, menunjuk ke arah kamar mandi dengan kontrak berdarah yang digulung.

8cab1fd6f49e.en: “Fine. I call the checking done!” Kibe lowered the contract, and stepped back to merge with the audience.
8cab1fd6f49e.t: “Baiklah. Pemeriksaan kunyatakan selesai!” Kibe menurunkan kontrak itu, dan mundur untuk berbaur dengan penonton.

90fe5f68db6e.en: Chapter VI subchapter 6: a furious girl with a red-tipped blade confronts Harry on a city street.
90fe5f68db6e.t: Bab VI subbab 6: seorang gadis yang murka dengan bilah berujung merah menghadang Harry di jalanan kota.

949b3eb98ec4.en: “Of course I am! Great to see Maiara find someone she likes!” The man held Harry’s shoulder. “I hope you will protect her well!” Looking at Princess Maiara, talking with Neferteri not far off, he let out a belly laugh. “Hahaha—well, not that you’d have to do much—right? Hehehe—” Fenafo, a man of corpulent size, belly laughed as he saw Itagiba browsing through the weapons.
949b3eb98ec4.t: “Tentu saja! Senang sekali melihat Maiara menemukan seseorang yang dia suka!” Pria itu memegang bahu Harry. “Semoga kau bisa melindunginya dengan baik!” Memandang Putri Maiara, yang sedang berbicara dengan Neferteri tak jauh dari situ, ia tertawa terbahak-bahak. “Hahaha—yah, bukan berarti kau harus berbuat banyak—kan? Hehehe—” Fenafo, pria bertubuh gemuk, tertawa terbahak-bahak saat melihat Itagiba melihat-lihat senjata.

97bcdaf5df7e.en: Walking towards him, Sora pulled out her badge from between her small breasts, and raised it above her head, as high as she could, even going as far as raising her feet and walking like a ballerina to see if it helped everyone notice her—it didn’t, but it was a cute attempt nonetheless.
97bcdaf5df7e.t: Berjalan ke arahnya, Sora mengeluarkan lencananya dari antara payudaranya yang kecil, dan mengangkatnya di atas kepalanya, setinggi mungkin, bahkan sampai berjinjit dan berjalan seperti balerina untuk melihat apakah itu membantu semua orang memperhatikannya—tidak membantu, tetapi tetap saja itu usaha yang imut.

988146654772.en: Gulping, Harry nodded at the king of Sanbi. I guess I’m not gonna say anything else.
988146654772.t: Menelan ludah, Harry mengangguk kepada raja Sanbi. Kurasa aku tidak akan bilang apa-apa lagi.

9a2aa8bc5f64.en: “Aurgh! Arugh!” The humanoid alligator agreed—maybe, at least it sounded like an agreement noise—or he was trying to bark like a dog.
9a2aa8bc5f64.t: “Aurgh! Arugh!” Humanoid aligator itu setuju—mungkin, setidaknya terdengar seperti bunyi setuju—atau ia sedang mencoba menggonggong seperti anjing.

9af8f35f9f60.en: “Blue and black!” Maiara replied with certainty with her tone, rotating her shoulders around, as she tightly gripped the hammer.
9af8f35f9f60.t: “Biru dan hitam!” jawab Maiara dengan nada yakin, memutar-mutar bahunya, sambil mencengkeram erat palunya.

9ef9efd87c89.en: Neferteri closed her eyes, and slowly nodded. Her throat was still swollen, so perhaps she was unable to speak at a normal volume.
9ef9efd87c89.t: Neferteri memejamkan matanya, dan perlahan mengangguk. Tenggorokannya masih bengkak, jadi mungkin ia tidak bisa berbicara dengan volume normal.

a00c7f054678.en: Feeling his, hers, or its coarse green scales covering its body, Harry felt a faintly cold sensation as he was hugged from the back, and lifted up from the ground.
a00c7f054678.t: Merasakan sisik hijau kasar miliknya—entah milik pria, wanita, atau makhluk itu—yang menutupi tubuhnya, Harry merasakan sensasi dingin yang samar saat ia dipeluk dari belakang, dan diangkat dari tanah.

a1ebac40d614.en: “Ain’t that right? That’s why I gotta find something that helps Harry out.” Itagiba picked up a large black sword with ease, and handed it over towards Harry, “Let’s try this.”
a1ebac40d614.t: “Betul, kan? Makanya aku harus mencari sesuatu yang bisa membantu Harry.” Itagiba mengangkat pedang hitam besar dengan mudah, dan menyerahkannya kepada Harry, “Coba yang ini.”

a2a73ba6948e.en: “Don’t worry, Fenafo, I did not forget it!” Itagiba, with a serious tone, gave a bright smile and a nod to Fenafo, watching him part way towards the nearest beer stand. Grabbing a far smaller sword, he exchanged it with Harry. “Remember! The size doesn’t matter, it’s how you penetrate it.” Itagiba smirked.
a2a73ba6948e.t: “Jangan khawatir, Fenafo, aku tidak melupakannya!” Itagiba, dengan nada serius, memberikan senyum cerah dan anggukan kepada Fenafo, memperhatikannya berjalan menuju kios bir terdekat. Mengambil pedang yang jauh lebih kecil, ia menukarnya dengan pedang Harry. “Ingat! Ukuran tidak penting, yang penting cara menusuknya.” Itagiba menyeringai.

a364ba519fde.en: “Pfff—like I fucking care! That fake eye ain’t gonna do shit to help him! Just call it already!” Maiara shrugged with a pout as she cracked her necks and hands.
a364ba519fde.t: “Pfff—memangnya aku peduli, bangsat! Fake eye itu tidak akan membantunya sedikit pun! Mulai saja!” Maiara mengangkat bahu dengan cemberut sambil meregangkan leher dan tangannya sampai berbunyi.

a45e365221bb.en: Harry walked back to the center where only Harry and Maiara would stand, but there were still quite a few people walking around. Harry’s hands trembled as he began hearing a constant loud thud coming from all over—at least echoing from all over. He looked around, and saw the same semicircular space devoid of people slowly forming around him and Maiara, while guards kept continuously hitting their bows against beer kegs. He felt the realness of the situation begin to set in as his heart sank.
a45e365221bb.t: Harry berjalan kembali ke tengah, tempat seharusnya hanya Harry dan Maiara yang berdiri, tetapi masih cukup banyak orang yang berlalu-lalang. Tangan Harry gemetar saat ia mulai mendengar bunyi debam keras yang konstan datang dari segala arah—setidaknya bergema dari segala arah. Ia memandang sekeliling, dan melihat ruang setengah lingkaran yang sama, yang kosong dari orang-orang, perlahan terbentuk di sekeliling dirinya dan Maiara, sementara para pengawal terus memukulkan busur mereka ke tong-tong bir. Ia merasakan kenyataan situasi itu mulai meresap saat hatinya tenggelam.

a6b745d8fad5.en: Eiri returned a smile towards him, but one could see the tremor in her eyes.
a6b745d8fad5.t: Eiri membalas dengan senyum kepadanya, tetapi orang bisa melihat getaran di matanya.

a7ca6818b53e.en: Kibe pointed towards Harry, standing still, observing the “check” with an estranged smile. As Sora approached him, he put his hand out, and feet apart just like Maiara. I hope Sora doesn’t start calling me a cunt too.
a7ca6818b53e.t: Kibe menunjuk ke arah Harry, yang berdiri diam, mengamati “pemeriksaan” itu dengan senyum canggung. Saat Sora mendekatinya, ia merentangkan tangannya, dan merenggangkan kakinya persis seperti Maiara. Semoga Sora tidak ikut-ikutan memanggilku memek.

a80dfee64e44.en: Apparently realizing being caught in the act, she jumped like a kitten being startled, and planted her face in her hands, shaking her head furiously in the process. “Hmhmhmhm—” A lovable embarrassed muffled scream came as she ran towards Eiri, hiding behind her back.
