a80dfee64e44.t: Tampaknya sadar tertangkap basah, ia melompat seperti anak kucing yang kaget, dan membenamkan wajahnya di tangannya, menggeleng-geleng hebat dalam prosesnya. “Hmhmhmhm—” Jeritan teredam yang malu dan menggemaskan keluar saat ia berlari ke arah Eiri, bersembunyi di balik punggungnya.

a9c2524c803b.en: “Y–yes.” A not-so-confident voice came out of Harry, feeling Itagiba’s muscles squeeze him a bit at the neck.
a9c2524c803b.t: “B–benar.” Suara yang tidak terlalu percaya diri keluar dari Harry, merasakan otot-otot Itagiba sedikit menekan lehernya.

aa524897963d.en: A nearby passerby overheard the conversation, and butted in, “Are you saying this is a sham fight?” His dark purple eyes looked like two precious stones. He wore dark red clothing, gray blue hair, and had the same Wozefaries qualities and height as Sora, but he was an older male instead.
aa524897963d.t: Seorang pejalan kaki di dekatnya mendengar percakapan itu, dan menyela, “Maksudmu ini pertarungan pura-pura?” Mata ungu tuanya tampak seperti dua batu permata. Ia mengenakan pakaian merah tua, berambut biru keabu-abuan, dan memiliki ciri-ciri Wozefaries serta tinggi badan yang sama seperti Sora, tetapi ia seorang pria yang lebih tua.

ab5fe6583f71.en: Itagiba let out a nervous chuckle, wrapping Harry in his shoulders. “Of course he fought before! He’s from the slum! We’re talking about Gandew duels, you curious winga!”
ab5fe6583f71.t: Itagiba terkekeh gugup, merangkul Harry di bahunya. “Tentu saja dia pernah bertarung! Dia dari permukiman kumuh! Kita sedang membicarakan duel Gandew, dasar winga kepo!”

abc2ec31c826.en: Harry waved back, noticing he had the same vein as Sora, but instead of being plain red, it had a faint white flame that seemed to be converted to spewing absolutely black flame, constantly changing its size across the vein appearing in both arms, and meeting on his back—like the monopropellant of a spaceship spewing out from within to finely adjust its orbit. His feet meanwhile, seemed to be dangling freely. Suddenly, Harry felt like he tripped on something, nearly falling on his face.
abc2ec31c826.t: Harry balas melambai, memperhatikan bahwa ia punya urat yang sama seperti Sora, tetapi alih-alih merah polos, urat itu memiliki api putih samar yang tampaknya diubah menjadi semburan api yang benar-benar hitam, terus berubah ukurannya di sepanjang urat yang tampak di kedua lengan, dan bertemu di punggungnya—seperti monopropelan pesawat luar angkasa yang menyembur dari dalam untuk menyesuaikan orbitnya dengan halus. Kakinya, sementara itu, tampak menggantung bebas. Tiba-tiba, Harry merasa tersandung sesuatu, nyaris jatuh tersungkur.

afc3d3e171f1.en: The crowd got serious, perhaps even a little exasperated by the words “five hundred sapphires.” Whispering began between some of them, while others somehow turned tail, and started competing to see who would arrive first at a reddish wagon with a sign saying Betting Wagon with an illustration of two large blue tickets, and balls of different colors right below it.
afc3d3e171f1.t: Kerumunan menjadi serius, mungkin bahkan sedikit jengkel mendengar kata-kata “lima ratus sapphire.” Bisik-bisik mulai terdengar di antara sebagian dari mereka, sementara yang lain entah bagaimana berbalik, dan mulai berlomba siapa yang lebih dulu sampai di sebuah kereta kemerahan dengan papan bertuliskan Betting Wagon dengan ilustrasi dua tiket biru besar, dan bola-bola berbagai warna tepat di bawahnya.

b07f5b1f4461.en: “It’s the rules,” Kibe spoke back with an annoyance oozing from his tone, he then turned around, taking out something from his pocket.
b07f5b1f4461.t: “Itu aturannya,” jawab Kibe dengan kekesalan yang meluap dari nadanya, ia lalu berbalik, mengeluarkan sesuatu dari sakunya.

b33772796365.en: With a quick fling of his hand, he threw the dice over the table, making one of the corners clang loudly against the stone pavement. Bouncing in the air, it revealed red on top, but as it landed it clanged again, flipping to show blue on top, then green, then with its last energy, the dice flipped again, showing black on top.
b33772796365.t: Dengan jentikan tangan yang cepat, ia melempar dadu ke seberang meja, membuat salah satu sudutnya berdentang keras menghantam jalan batu. Memantul di udara, dadu itu memperlihatkan merah di atas, tetapi saat mendarat dadu itu berdentang lagi, berguling memperlihatkan biru di atas, lalu hijau, lalu dengan sisa tenaganya, dadu itu berguling lagi, memperlihatkan hitam di atas.

b4352ec83e99.en: “But here’s the catch, you can counterattack as long as it is a defensive move.” Itagiba pointed to Harry’s shortsword. “When she is about to strike you, raise the Tolerideme shield so that your arm takes the brunt of it, then stab her in the belly with the other hand.” Itagiba made an okay sign, “That should make things interesting for everyone.”
b4352ec83e99.t: “Tapi ini triknya, kau boleh melakukan serangan balik selama itu gerakan bertahan.” Itagiba menunjuk pedang pendek Harry. “Waktu dia hendak memukulmu, angkat perisai Tolerideme supaya lenganmu yang menahan beban pukulannya, lalu tusuk perutnya dengan tangan yang lain.” Itagiba membuat isyarat oke, “Itu bakal bikin semuanya jadi menarik buat semua orang.”

b4f59a27ff49.en: “Then get it over with.” Kibe closed the door.
b4f59a27ff49.t: “Kalau begitu cepat selesaikan.” Kibe menutup pintu.

b6612303a06b.en: Cheers came from the rowdy crowd, feeling the energy coming from Itagiba’s willed soul. However, as the second passed a wave of questioning began rising from within. “Sanbi-eye? What’s that?” A stranger’s voice near Harry sounded off.
b6612303a06b.t: Sorakan datang dari kerumunan yang riuh, merasakan energi yang datang dari jiwa Itagiba yang penuh tekad. Namun, seiring detik berlalu, gelombang pertanyaan mulai muncul dari dalam kerumunan. “Sanbi-eye? Apa itu?” Suara orang asing di dekat Harry terdengar.

b68b1dc62c23.en: Chapter VI subchapter 5: Harry and a young man in blue at a busy market beside a large blue fish statue fountain.
b68b1dc62c23.t: Bab VI subbab 5: Harry dan seorang pemuda berpakaian biru di pasar yang ramai di samping air mancur berpatung ikan biru besar.

b7ae3204f80e.en: “Grrrr!” an alligator-like humanoid, with a large snout in its face, stood on two legs, with a large tail protruding from his lower back, from underneath a large shirt that went down its knees. The creature gargled, or grunted as it held its tail in pain. Aside from the simple shirt, this creature also wore a hat with the name Fico written on the sides, plus also what appeared to be a chain around its neck, holding a book with a leather pocket where a charcoal piece stuck out.
b7ae3204f80e.t: “Grrrr!” sesosok humanoid mirip aligator, dengan moncong besar di wajahnya, berdiri dengan dua kaki, dengan ekor besar yang menjulur dari punggung bawahnya, dari balik kemeja besar yang panjangnya sampai lutut. Makhluk itu mendeguk, atau mendengus sambil memegangi ekornya kesakitan. Selain kemeja sederhana itu, makhluk ini juga memakai topi bertuliskan nama Fico di sisi-sisinya, ditambah sesuatu yang tampak seperti rantai di lehernya, yang menggantung sebuah buku dengan kantong kulit tempat sebatang arang menyembul.

b86880ca0c1c.en: “Absofuckinlutely. Wanna bet a beer there’s gonna be at least two rounds?” Itagiba’s chuckles turned serious, ready to throw down a fight of his own.
b86880ca0c1c.t: “Jelas banget, bangsat. Mau taruhan satu bir bakal ada setidaknya dua ronde?” Kekehan Itagiba berubah serius, siap memulai perkelahiannya sendiri.

b91cb61bdbf1.en: A loud gasp came from Harry, trying to breathe in, but a suffocating darkness prevented him from grabbing much air. Whaaaat?
b91cb61bdbf1.t: Tarikan napas keras keluar dari Harry, yang berusaha menghirup udara, tetapi kegelapan yang menyesakkan mencegahnya mendapatkan banyak udara. Apaaaa?

bce4b5bc2bb7.en: Chapter VI subchapter 4: Harry, looking relieved, with a red-haired girl leaning on his shoulder in a crowd.
bce4b5bc2bb7.t: Bab VI subbab 4: Harry, tampak lega, dengan seorang gadis berambut merah bersandar di bahunya di tengah kerumunan.

bd288dc08c89.en: Harry did as told, but his body was not pleased, or prepared for a live session of yoga. The joint of his knees cracked, and his legs felt like he was carrying a dead cow on his shoulders. At the same time a small rip could be heard—coincidentally coming from his behind. Somehow, he was able to get to the requested position.
bd288dc08c89.t: Harry melakukan apa yang disuruh, tetapi tubuhnya tidak senang, atau siap, untuk sesi yoga langsung. Sendi lututnya berderak, dan kakinya terasa seperti sedang memikul sapi mati di bahunya. Pada saat yang sama, bunyi robekan kecil terdengar—kebetulan datang dari bagian belakangnya. Entah bagaimana, ia berhasil mencapai posisi yang diminta.

be8311bef236.en: “You said to me you wanted to do it! Now go do it! C’mon Sora!” Eiri hugged her, prying her from her back, towards her side, then walking her towards Harry. “Harry, can you extend your hands towards her?”
be8311bef236.t: “Kamu bilang padaku kamu mau melakukannya! Sekarang lakukan! Ayo, Sora!” Eiri memeluknya, melepaskannya dari punggungnya, ke sampingnya, lalu menuntunnya ke arah Harry. “Harry, bisa kamu ulurkan tanganmu ke arahnya?”

bff0e138384d.en: A sudden sharp stabbing pain rocked through the back of his neck, penetrating deep, and releasing a cold concoction into his bloodstream. His heart immediately raced, then a surge of adrenaline rose from deep in his guts as the claustrophobia kicked in. “ARGH!” Harry screamed into the pillow, trying to move his hand, but it did not result in much. Although he did find the slender, smooth skin of what appeared to be a foot, as soon as he touched what he thought was its sole, a mischievous female laugh ensued. In what appeared to be some sort of retribution, he felt an incredibly sharp nerve pain, coming from the girl further putting pressure on Harry’s pinned arms with what had to be her knees.
bff0e138384d.t: Rasa sakit menusuk yang tajam dan tiba-tiba mengguncang tengkuknya, menembus dalam, dan melepaskan ramuan dingin ke aliran darahnya. Jantungnya seketika berpacu, lalu lonjakan adrenalin naik dari dalam perutnya saat rasa klaustrofobia menyerang. “ARGH!” Harry berteriak ke bantal, mencoba menggerakkan tangannya, tetapi tidak banyak hasilnya. Walaupun ia memang menemukan kulit ramping dan halus dari sesuatu yang tampaknya kaki, begitu ia menyentuh apa yang ia kira telapak kakinya, tawa perempuan yang nakal menyusul. Dalam apa yang tampak seperti semacam pembalasan, ia merasakan sakit saraf yang luar biasa tajam, dari gadis itu yang semakin menekan lengan Harry yang terkunci dengan apa yang pasti lututnya.

c09c98182313.en: “Move your badge up, you dipshit!” Maiara, speaking through her grinning teeth, looked ready to perform an impromptu teeth removal surgery with her fist.
c09c98182313.t: “Angkat lencanamu, dasar tolol!” Maiara, berbicara di balik giginya yang menyeringai, tampak siap melakukan operasi pencabutan gigi dadakan dengan kepalan tangannya.

c0bd8fdfc329.en: Harry, with teary eyes, dry heaved for one last time. Spitting thick saliva in the sink, he then let out a groan as he let his neck relax. “I—dunno—I’m sorry.”
c0bd8fdfc329.t: Harry, dengan mata berlinang, muntah kering untuk terakhir kalinya. Meludahkan air liur yang kental ke wastafel, ia lalu mengerang sambil mengendurkan lehernya. “Aku—entahlah—maaf.”

c32f69058f65.en: “What the fuck? He’s done—” Maiara pointed her bloodied hammer towards Harry standing up, but still leaning heavily on the alligator humanoid.
c32f69058f65.t: “Apa-apaan, bangsat? Dia sudah habis—” Maiara mengarahkan palunya yang berdarah ke arah Harry yang berdiri, tetapi masih bersandar berat pada humanoid aligator itu.

c3f07dd9a1f4.en: “Sweet. Let’s get this show on the road. Harry, go back to the middle.” Itagiba shooed Harry towards where Maiara stood by herself, then he raised his thumb to nearby guards.
c3f07dd9a1f4.t: “Mantap. Ayo kita mulai pertunjukannya. Harry, kembali ke tengah.” Itagiba mengusir Harry ke arah tempat Maiara berdiri sendirian, lalu ia mengacungkan jempol ke para pengawal di dekatnya.

c441ed5380cb.en: Doing as told, Harry struggled with buttoning his shirt again. That was until he pictured Eiri slapping his gut. Taking a deep breath, he pulled in his enlarged stomach with all his might, straining his face, and successfully buttoning his shirt in a swift move. Angering the water spirits by daring to open the water valve atop the sink, he then cleaned his face, and refreshed his hair—although an actual bath was definitely in order as he smelled sweaty, and his armpits were developing their own signature stench. Going back to the bedroom, he slipped on his shoes, then followed Kibe after he left him behind.
c441ed5380cb.t: Menurut, Harry kembali berjuang mengancingkan kemejanya. Sampai ia membayangkan Eiri menepuk perutnya. Menarik napas dalam-dalam, ia menahan perutnya yang membesar dengan sekuat tenaga, menegangkan wajahnya, dan berhasil mengancingkan kemejanya dalam satu gerakan cepat. Membuat murka roh-roh air dengan berani membuka katup air di atas wastafel, ia lalu membersihkan wajahnya, dan menyegarkan rambutnya—walaupun mandi sungguhan jelas diperlukan karena ia berbau keringat, dan ketiaknya mulai mengembangkan bau khasnya sendiri. Kembali ke kamar tidur, ia memakai sepatunya, lalu menyusul Kibe yang sudah meninggalkannya.

c792ca60a442.en: Noticing Harry being silent, Neferteri continued speaking with the same elegance, and confidence as a president's speech, while also sounding just as canned, and heavily rehearsed too, “Harry came from the Sanbi slums, and due to an unfortunate accident, he lost all his memories. Princess Maiara saw beauty in him, while we, Sanbi royals, saw an opportunity for him to become something bigger than himself. However, nothing in this world is for free—”
c792ca60a442.t: Menyadari Harry diam saja, Neferteri melanjutkan berbicara dengan keanggunan dan kepercayaan diri yang sama seperti pidato presiden, sekaligus terdengar sama hafalannya, dan sangat terlatih juga, “Harry berasal dari permukiman kumuh Sanbi, dan karena kecelakaan yang malang, ia kehilangan semua ingatannya. Putri Maiara melihat keindahan dalam dirinya, sementara kami, para Sanbi royal, melihat kesempatan baginya untuk menjadi sesuatu yang lebih besar dari dirinya sendiri. Namun, tidak ada yang gratis di dunia ini—”

c7c056369f60.en: Meanwhile, Neferteri walked by nearby, and started to handle the hourglass-like artifact, flipping switches, and shaking it to make some of the sand disappear behind a trapdoor on the side.
c7c056369f60.t: Sementara itu, Neferteri berjalan lewat di dekatnya, dan mulai mengurus artefak mirip jam pasir itu, membalik-balik sakelar, dan mengguncangnya agar sebagian pasirnya menghilang di balik pintu jebakan di sampingnya.

c9f123557205.en: Suddenly, a vision of what appeared to be a distant, murky dream came to him. He saw himself gasping for air, unable to move, fearing something humanoid in shape taking the life out of his eyes. Gasping for air, cold sweats bubbled up on Harry’s forehead. He then felt an off-balance sensation, as if he was on a small boat in the ocean being thrown around in a seesaw motion. He felt this sensation within him explode, as if he was in extreme danger, and he had to do something right that instant—but who knew what. He dry heaved on the sink, holding himself to it as if his life depended on it, while his heart pounded hard as if was running away from someone holding a bloodied knife. Whatever this sudden sensation was, it started to disappear as fast as it spiked up.
c9f123557205.t: Tiba-tiba, sebuah penglihatan tentang sesuatu yang tampak seperti mimpi jauh yang keruh datang kepadanya. Ia melihat dirinya terengah-engah mencari udara, tidak bisa bergerak, takut akan sesuatu berbentuk humanoid yang merenggut kehidupan dari matanya. Terengah-engah mencari udara, keringat dingin bermunculan di dahi Harry. Ia lalu merasakan sensasi tidak seimbang, seolah berada di perahu kecil di lautan yang diombang-ambingkan naik turun. Ia merasakan sensasi di dalam dirinya ini meledak, seolah ia dalam bahaya besar, dan harus melakukan sesuatu saat itu juga—tetapi siapa yang tahu apa. Ia muntah kering di wastafel, berpegangan padanya seolah hidupnya bergantung pada itu, sementara jantungnya berdebar keras seolah sedang kabur dari seseorang yang memegang pisau berlumur darah. Apa pun sensasi mendadak ini, sensasi itu mulai menghilang secepat munculnya.

ca59e9496c1f.en: Harry felt nothing, but as the seconds passed, the hum of a tinnitus began rising, and rising, until it was deafening loudly. The roar of the crowds was next, then the feeling of something coarse that Harry was resting against. His vision came next, but his left eye was blurry, and reddened. The first thing he saw was an alligator in the shape of a humanoid, but with a large hat partly covering his hair with the name Honito written on the side.
ca59e9496c1f.t: Harry tidak merasakan apa-apa, tetapi seiring detik berlalu, dengung tinitus mulai naik, dan naik, sampai memekakkan telinga. Raungan kerumunan menyusul, lalu perasaan sesuatu yang kasar tempat Harry bersandar. Penglihatannya menyusul berikutnya, tetapi mata kirinya buram, dan memerah. Hal pertama yang ia lihat adalah seekor aligator berbentuk humanoid, tetapi dengan topi besar yang sebagian menutupi rambutnya dengan nama Honito tertulis di sampingnya.

caef10ba9be1.en: Looking around the bathroom, Harry looked around for something to wear, but there was nothing. “Can you pick it up for me, please?”
caef10ba9be1.t: Melihat sekeliling kamar mandi, Harry mencari sesuatu untuk dipakai, tetapi tidak ada apa-apa. “Bisa tolong ambilkan untukku?”

cb53cfad02e9.en: Kibe let out a groan, and bent to the side to hear what she had to say. Kibe loudly murmured, “Hm-hm—oh?—huh?—I see—okay. Got it!” before standing up, and half-heartedly raising the contract. “Harry only has Fake Eye right now, but Sora tasted a bunch of what appears to be hardcore stuff that was injected in him beforehand. They do not appear to be active at the moment—Maiara?”
cb53cfad02e9.t: Kibe mengerang, dan membungkuk ke samping untuk mendengar apa yang ingin dikatakan Sora. Kibe bergumam keras, “Hm-hm—oh?—hah?—begitu—oke. Paham!” sebelum berdiri, dan dengan setengah hati mengangkat kontrak itu. “Saat ini Harry hanya punya Fake Eye, tapi Sora mencicipi sejumlah zat yang tampaknya berat yang disuntikkan ke dalam dirinya sebelumnya. Zat-zat itu tampaknya tidak aktif saat ini—Maiara?”

cc833afea7af.en: “I bet ten pearls it’s a fake body.” A woman in pink retorted. “No way that’s what Maiara likes. Have you seen Yacamin’s husband?”
cc833afea7af.t: “Aku taruhan sepuluh pearl itu fake body.” Seorang wanita berbaju merah muda membalas. “Tidak mungkin itu yang Maiara suka. Kamu sudah lihat suaminya Yacamin?”

cca0d699e393.en: The crowd grew quieter, seeing Maiara putting herself at a good distance from Harry, then adjusting herself and her weapon. With a sudden burst, she took off after Harry, grunting loudly.
cca0d699e393.t: Kerumunan menjadi lebih tenang, melihat Maiara mengambil jarak yang cukup jauh dari Harry, lalu menyiapkan dirinya dan senjatanya. Dengan ledakan tiba-tiba, ia berlari menerjang Harry, mendengus keras.

ccfeb30bbc8c.en: Harry felt time slow down. He could see her pace growing faster and faster. He could feel her hammer rushing in the wind. His right hand, holding the short sword, immediately dropped it, and rushed to help his desperate left hand, trying to prop his shield as hard as he could, assuming that’s where the hammer was gonna land. On her last steps flying towards him, he could even see her uvula, and the small pupils of her eyes. Harry last saw her long ponytail, violently swinging the wind, just before the weapon made a loud bang on the shield.
ccfeb30bbc8c.t: Harry merasakan waktu melambat. Ia bisa melihat langkahnya semakin cepat dan semakin cepat. Ia bisa merasakan palunya membelah angin. Tangan kanannya, yang memegang pedang pendek, langsung menjatuhkannya, dan bergegas membantu tangan kirinya yang putus asa, berusaha menopang perisainya sekuat mungkin, dengan asumsi di situlah palu itu akan mendarat. Pada langkah-langkah terakhirnya yang melayang ke arahnya, ia bahkan bisa melihat anak lidahnya, dan pupil matanya yang kecil. Terakhir kali Harry melihat kuncir kudanya yang panjang, terayun keras membelah angin, tepat sebelum senjata itu menghantam perisainya dengan dentuman keras.

ce7bc0e1ae34.en: Harry did so, and held the badge with his hands as if it was a good luck charm.
ce7bc0e1ae34.t: Harry melakukannya, dan memegang lencana itu dengan tangannya seolah itu jimat keberuntungan.

cf28b6bfabec.en: “That’s okay. Let’s go tell Kibe what you found.” Eiri walked Sora towards Kibe, holding her tightly from the side, seeming to give a bit of comfort from the sea of eyes looking at them.
cf28b6bfabec.t: “Tidak apa-apa. Ayo kita beri tahu Kibe apa yang kamu temukan.” Eiri menuntun Sora ke arah Kibe, memeluknya erat dari samping, tampaknya memberi sedikit kenyamanan dari lautan mata yang memandang mereka.

cf66e8d52726.en: Harry looked back at Kibe, and saw him shift his gaze away from him, then walk towards the door. Looking down at his pelvis, he instead saw his hairy belly blocking most of his exposed down-under companion from his eyes. “Oh! Sorry!” Harry’s eyes startled, and he looked like he was electrocuted, quickly jumping towards the bathroom, and closing the door.
cf66e8d52726.t: Harry menoleh ke Kibe, dan melihatnya mengalihkan pandangan darinya, lalu berjalan ke arah pintu. Menunduk melihat panggulnya, ia malah melihat perutnya yang berbulu menutupi sebagian besar teman bawahnya yang terbuka dari pandangannya. “Oh! Maaf!” Mata Harry terbelalak kaget, dan ia tampak seperti tersetrum, cepat-cepat melompat ke kamar mandi, dan menutup pintu.

d422abc6bc27.en: Itagiba caught everyone's attention when he struck the hourglass-like artifact onto the table “ALL RIGHT, MY PEEPS! PLACE YOUR BETS! WET YOUR LIPS! AND GET READY TO CELEBRATE! YOU GOT A SMALL TIMEHUNK BEFORE THE DUEL STARTS!”
d422abc6bc27.t: Itagiba menarik perhatian semua orang ketika ia menghentakkan artefak mirip jam pasir itu ke meja, “BAIKLAH, KAWAN-KAWANKU! PASANG TARUHAN KALIAN! BASAHI BIBIR KALIAN! DAN BERSIAPLAH UNTUK BERPESTA! KALIAN PUNYA SATU TIMEHUNK KECIL SEBELUM DUELNYA DIMULAI!”

d650b50f8576.en: A hand slammed Harry’s head into the pillow, muffling his screams. “Shut the fuck up!” A cold sounding girly voice oozed with anger.
d650b50f8576.t: Sebuah tangan membanting kepala Harry ke bantal, meredam teriakannya. “Diam, bangsat!” Suara feminin yang terdengar dingin itu meluapkan amarah.

dd6327cda8cd.en: “Yes—my apologies, Princess Maiara. I will be as fast as I can.” Sora’s reddened face drew straight, paying attention as she started to sniff stuff like a dog. Crouching down, she smelled her feet, then up her legs, hovering near her privates, then finishing up by smelling her stomach, and lower back. “Please—princess Maiara—close your eyes and—”
dd6327cda8cd.t: “Baik—mohon maaf, Putri Maiara. Saya akan secepat mungkin.” Wajah Sora yang memerah menjadi serius, berkonsentrasi saat ia mulai mengendus-endus seperti anjing. Berjongkok, ia mencium kakinya, lalu naik ke tungkainya, melayang di dekat kemaluannya, lalu diakhiri dengan mencium perut dan punggung bawahnya. “Tolong—putri Maiara—pejamkan mata Anda dan—”

ddff84a43ee0.en: Being among people is one thing, but being surrounded by them is an entirely different thing. At least that’s what Harry’s anxiety told him as he felt something stuck in his throat now that everyone’s eyes were really on him. His hands tried to hide themselves away in the pocket of his pants, but there were no pockets, so they just fumbled around, having no idea what to do—nearly dropping his badge in the process.
ddff84a43ee0.t: Berada di antara orang-orang adalah satu hal, tetapi dikelilingi oleh mereka adalah hal yang sama sekali berbeda. Setidaknya begitulah kata kecemasan Harry saat ia merasakan sesuatu tersangkut di tenggorokannya sekarang ketika mata semua orang benar-benar tertuju padanya. Tangannya mencoba bersembunyi di saku celananya, tetapi tidak ada saku, jadi tangannya hanya meraba-raba, tidak tahu harus berbuat apa—nyaris menjatuhkan lencananya dalam prosesnya.

e2fa9bbf1c61.en: Kibe looked towards Sanbi royals. The already kinda silent festival grew pretty dead; everyone focused their attention on Neferteri.
e2fa9bbf1c61.t: Kibe memandang ke arah para Sanbi royal. Festival yang sudah agak sunyi itu menjadi cukup senyap; semua orang memusatkan perhatian pada Neferteri.

e3129db6957e.en: That was until he suddenly gasped, waking up in the bathtub, sitting forward, while Sora was carefully brushing his back. Harry wanted to look at her, but it felt like he couldn’t—her tantalizing petite naked body was calling out for him, but he just couldn’t bring himself to actually do it. He wanted to know more, but at the same time he didn’t want her to stop caressing his back. Plus, the warmth of the bathtub was simply too great. Hugging his knees, Harry let out a deep breath, looking at the bubbly water slowly waving around, having a rather calming effect. His mind was devoid of thought, just appreciating the serenity of that moment.
e3129db6957e.t: Sampai tiba-tiba ia tersentak, terbangun di bak mandi, duduk membungkuk ke depan, sementara Sora dengan hati-hati menggosok punggungnya. Harry ingin memandangnya, tetapi rasanya ia tidak bisa—tubuh mungilnya yang telanjang dan menggoda memanggil-manggilnya, tetapi ia tidak bisa membuat dirinya benar-benar melakukannya. Ia ingin tahu lebih banyak, tetapi pada saat yang sama ia tidak ingin Sora berhenti membelai punggungnya. Lagi pula, hangatnya bak mandi terlalu nikmat. Memeluk lututnya, Harry mengembuskan napas dalam-dalam, memandangi air berbusa yang perlahan bergoyang, yang memberi efek cukup menenangkan. Pikirannya kosong tanpa pikiran apa pun, hanya menikmati ketenangan saat itu.

e5a10089f5f9.en: Harry no longer had the strength to even move his head away from the pillow to draw fresh air. Instead, he kept gasping, feeling the impending doom of the encroaching darkness knocking at his door. Help! Harry tried to scream again, but only his mind murmured the words, while his mouth just let out a gargle. He pictured himself on the warmth of Eiri’s shoulder again as his eyes grew teary. His entire body now merged with the bed; he could not feel where things started, or ended—in a way he had become one with the universe.
e5a10089f5f9.t: Harry tidak lagi punya tenaga bahkan untuk menggerakkan kepalanya menjauh dari bantal untuk menghirup udara segar. Sebaliknya, ia terus terengah-engah, merasakan malapetaka dari kegelapan yang merayap mengetuk pintunya. Tolong! Harry mencoba berteriak lagi, tetapi hanya pikirannya yang menggumamkan kata-kata itu, sementara mulutnya hanya mengeluarkan bunyi berdeguk. Ia membayangkan dirinya lagi di bahu Eiri yang hangat sementara matanya berlinang. Seluruh tubuhnya kini menyatu dengan ranjang; ia tidak bisa merasakan di mana sesuatu berawal, atau berakhir—dalam arti tertentu ia telah menyatu dengan alam semesta.

e5e55c006fc5.en: “Ow? That’s easy. Maiara is confident in her hammer, but she is wide open when it comes to defense. Just stab her again to slow her down as both of you can’t heal between turns.” Itagiba looked at Harry’s weapons. “Just pour your heart into it, and you’re gonna be fine. Remember, we’re all here to have fun.”
e5e55c006fc5.t: “Oh? Itu gampang. Maiara percaya diri dengan palunya, tapi pertahanannya terbuka lebar. Tusuk saja dia lagi untuk memperlambatnya karena kalian berdua tidak bisa menyembuhkan diri di antara giliran.” Itagiba memandang senjata-senjata Harry. “Curahkan saja seluruh hatimu, dan kau akan baik-baik saja. Ingat, kita semua di sini untuk bersenang-senang.”

e6ca0d633f5b.en: Itagiba whispered towards Harry’s ear, “We’re here to throw a party, don’t be negative or you will ruin the mood.” He looked at Harry with fervor in his eyes, silently waiting for Harry to confirm.
e6ca0d633f5b.t: Itagiba berbisik ke telinga Harry, “Kita di sini untuk berpesta, jangan negatif atau kau akan merusak suasana.” Ia memandang Harry dengan semangat di matanya, diam-diam menunggu Harry mengiyakan.

e94dc8104327.en: Itagiba picked up a large, colored dice. His hands, holding the weight of the metal construct, pointed it towards Maiara.
e94dc8104327.t: Itagiba mengambil sebuah dadu besar berwarna. Tangannya, yang menahan berat konstruksi logam itu, mengarahkannya ke Maiara.

e97f4edd1b8a.en: Kibe continued, now pointing the contract towards Sora, already reddened in the face, involuntarily holding her skirt—nearly tearing the stitches apart by sheer embarrassment, looking like she knew her fate. “Sora Sanbi Blue-Grass is gonna do the check.”
e97f4edd1b8a.t: Kibe melanjutkan, kini mengarahkan kontrak itu ke Sora, yang wajahnya sudah memerah, tanpa sadar memegangi roknya—nyaris merobek jahitannya karena rasa malu yang luar biasa, tampak seolah tahu nasibnya. “Sora Sanbi Blue-Grass akan melakukan pemeriksaan.”

ea9c7ef485e3.en: Harry’s voice sounded like his throat was bone dry. “Red—and yellow?”
ea9c7ef485e3.t: Suara Harry terdengar seolah tenggorokannya kering kerontang. “Merah—dan kuning?”

eaab9d164f68.en: “My daughter! Show him what you are made of!” Itagiba let out a wide smile, grabbing another beer bottle from a Sanbi maid.
eaab9d164f68.t: “Anakku! Tunjukkan padanya siapa dirimu!” Itagiba tersenyum lebar, mengambil sebotol bir lagi dari seorang pelayan Sanbi.

ec7085f4055a.en: Itagiba showed the dice towards Harry, but this time he moved the dice around, giving him the opportunity to see all the color possibilities: blue, red, yellow, green, black, and white.
ec7085f4055a.t: Itagiba menunjukkan dadu itu kepada Harry, tetapi kali ini ia memutar-mutar dadu itu, memberinya kesempatan untuk melihat semua kemungkinan warna: biru, merah, kuning, hijau, hitam, dan putih.

ed4507719dd6.en: Harry looked at Maiara in the background, also glancing towards him with a large tribal-like hammer in hand. A chilling sensation went down his spine, feeling the theoretical weight of it coming down at him.
ed4507719dd6.t: Harry memandang Maiara di latar belakang, yang juga melirik ke arahnya dengan palu besar bergaya suku di tangan. Sensasi dingin menjalari tulang punggungnya, merasakan berat teoretis palu itu menghantam dirinya.

ed6029323f26.en: Itagiba, meanwhile, picked up an artifact that looked like an hourglass, but had a thicker wooden structure around it, with three switches on the side. He played with them, then shook the artifact around.
ed6029323f26.t: Itagiba, sementara itu, mengambil sebuah artefak yang tampak seperti jam pasir, tetapi dengan struktur kayu yang lebih tebal di sekelilingnya, dengan tiga sakelar di sampingnya. Ia memainkannya, lalu mengguncang-guncang artefak itu.

f12d0efc199e.en: Where did I put it? Harry glanced around the bedroom, but could not find his clothes—at least until he walked past the bed, and found them, on a pile in the ground close to where Kibe was standing. Grabbing them, and making his way back to the bathroom, Harry quickly put on his black underwear, pants, and socks only to realize that he was smelling something different all this time. It was like sweat, but also faintly sweet. He looked at himself in the large mirror hanging on the door. It was still him, but now he started to feel more like him—rather than expecting an even fatter man wearing glasses. Focusing on his face, he did not see anything, even though he for sure could feel this slightly dried slimy feeling. He touched it, took a whiff, and ended up tasting it too. What is this?—hmm—it’s not bad.
f12d0efc199e.t: Di mana aku menaruhnya? Harry melirik ke sekeliling kamar tidur, tetapi tidak bisa menemukan pakaiannya—setidaknya sampai ia berjalan melewati ranjang, dan menemukannya, bertumpuk di lantai dekat tempat Kibe berdiri. Mengambilnya, dan kembali ke kamar mandi, Harry cepat-cepat memakai celana dalam hitam, celana panjang, dan kaus kakinya, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa sedari tadi ia mencium bau yang berbeda. Seperti keringat, tetapi juga samar-samar manis. Ia memandang dirinya di cermin besar yang tergantung di pintu. Itu masih dirinya, tetapi sekarang ia mulai merasa lebih seperti dirinya sendiri—alih-alih mengharapkan pria yang lebih gemuk lagi yang memakai kacamata. Memusatkan perhatian pada wajahnya, ia tidak melihat apa-apa, walaupun ia jelas bisa merasakan sensasi berlendir yang agak mengering ini. Ia menyentuhnya, mengendusnya, dan akhirnya mencicipinya juga. Apa ini?—hmm—lumayan juga.

f39eaab3ff3b.en: Before the stranger knew it, everything became black—
f39eaab3ff3b.t: Sebelum orang asing itu menyadarinya, semuanya menjadi hitam—

f5f22c993f96.en: The lively crowd quieted down, all paying attention to the Sanbi Royals standing right in front of the Sanbi statue fountain.
f5f22c993f96.t: Kerumunan yang riuh itu menjadi tenang, semuanya memperhatikan para Sanbi Royal yang berdiri tepat di depan air mancur patung Sanbi.

f6be2611d54a.en: Chapter VI subchapter 2: the silver-haired man holds a vial over Harry, who lies shirtless on a bed.
f6be2611d54a.t: Bab VI subbab 2: pria berambut perak memegang sebuah botol kecil di atas Harry, yang berbaring bertelanjang dada di ranjang.

fb06db46807d.en: With tears still streaming down his face, Harry heard the energy of the crowd penetrate his eyes and ears. He looked towards Eiri and saw Sora still hiding away in her back, but Eiri herself was looking back at him, cleaning away tears as her saddened lips held back much to say.
fb06db46807d.t: Dengan air mata yang masih mengalir di wajahnya, Harry mendengar energi kerumunan menembus mata dan telinganya. Ia memandang ke arah Eiri dan melihat Sora masih bersembunyi di balik punggungnya, tetapi Eiri sendiri balas memandangnya, menyeka air mata sementara bibirnya yang sedih menahan banyak hal untuk dikatakan.

fb2745665f00.en: Stab her in the belly? Harry brought the shortsword to a closer view, and looked at Maiara’s belly as she walked back towards where she previously stood up. Harry’s breath grew shallow, and his skin pale. His hands went next, beginning to tremble as he rehearsed the defense in his mind, until something clicked. “Attack! What about attacking?”
fb2745665f00.t: Tusuk perutnya? Harry mendekatkan pedang pendek itu untuk dilihat, dan memandang perut Maiara saat ia berjalan kembali ke tempatnya berdiri tadi. Napas Harry menjadi dangkal, dan kulitnya pucat. Tangannya menyusul, mulai gemetar saat ia melatih gerakan bertahan itu di benaknya, sampai sesuatu terlintas. “Menyerang! Bagaimana dengan menyerang?”

fc79ca4b84ab.en: “It’s fine! Right, my people?” Itagiba raised his beer bottle.
fc79ca4b84ab.t: “Tidak apa-apa! Benar, kan, rakyatku?” Itagiba mengangkat botol birnya.

fe0ceef3170e.en: Nodding, Harry made a motion to sit up in bed. A groan came out of him, feeling sore, as if he had just ran a marathon. His neck felt funny too, from maybe sleeping wrongly, but it was also quite tender—like he tried to show off by deadlifting far more than what he could. He stood up and lay his feet on the cold floor, finally feeling them as if they were not there just now. Standing up, his thighs, and back were slightly out of balance, and he felt some sort of vertigo kick in, which somehow disappeared as he started to get his blood moving, slowly walking towards the bathroom.
fe0ceef3170e.t: Mengangguk, Harry bergerak untuk duduk di ranjang. Erangan keluar darinya, merasa pegal, seolah baru saja lari maraton. Lehernya juga terasa aneh, mungkin karena salah posisi tidur, tetapi juga cukup nyeri—seperti mencoba pamer dengan angkat beban jauh melebihi kemampuannya. Ia bangkit dan menapakkan kakinya di lantai yang dingin, akhirnya merasakan kakinya seolah tadi kaki itu tidak ada. Berdiri, paha dan punggungnya sedikit tidak seimbang, dan ia merasakan semacam vertigo menyerang, yang entah bagaimana menghilang saat darahnya mulai bergerak, perlahan berjalan menuju kamar mandi.

ffb150e85a09.en: The crowd cheered back. “Go Harry! Go Harry! Go Harry!”
ffb150e85a09.t: Kerumunan balas bersorak. “Ayo Harry! Ayo Harry! Ayo Harry!”
